name: Precision Power Scope
description_raw: The PX8000 is described as the world's first precision power scope, combining Yokogawa power-measurement technology with oscilloscope-style time-based measurement for R&D work on transient power phenomena. It uses plug-in voltage, current and AUX modules (max. 8 modules, max. 4 power measurement elements, max. 8 channels) with 12-bit resolution, 100 MS/s sampling and 20 MHz bandwidth. Functions include cycle-by-cycle trend calculation, specific time-period (start/stop cursor) measurement, harmonic analysis up to the 500th order, FFT, X-Y and vector display, de-skew compensation and a History function storing up to 1000 waveforms. It is powered by Yokogawa's isoPRO isolation technology and is the new flagship of the Yokogawa power analyzer range.

name: High Performance Power Analyzer
description_raw: The WT1800E is a high performance power analyzer with up to 6 input channels sampling at 2 MS/s with 16-bit resolution, aimed at engineers measuring power, power quality and efficiency. It guarantees a basic power accuracy of ±(0.05% of reading + 0.05% of range) over an effective input range of 1% to 110% of the selected voltage and current range and offers a measurement bandwidth of DC, 0.1 Hz to 1 MHz. Harmonic analysis is possible up to the 500th order of a 50/60 Hz fundamental even at a 50 ms data update interval. The 8.4 inch XGA display can show up to 6 waveforms in split screen and up to 12 pages of measurement parameters, and features include power integration with auto ranging, high speed data capture, delta computation, motor evaluation and up to 20 user-defined computations. Typical applications include inverter and motor testing, hybrid/electric vehicles, photovoltaic and wind power conditioners, appliances, IT equipment and aircraft power systems.

name: Precision Power Analyzer
description_raw: The WT1800R is a precision power analyzer supporting power measurements on up to 6 input channels, making it suited to evaluating input/output efficiency of inverter-motor systems in electric vehicles. It uses 16-bit resolution with approximately 500 ns sampling period (2 MS/s high-speed sampling) and supports a measurement lower limit frequency of 0.1 Hz so harmonics can be measured at very low motor rotation speeds without an external sampling clock. An optional motor evaluation function measures rotation speed, torque and mechanical output power from analog/pulse outputs of rotation or torque sensors, including electrical angle and rotation direction. Additional functions include an individual null (offset correction) per input for voltage, current and motor signals, charge/discharge integration of positive and negative power and current, and D/A output of measurement data on up to 20 channels.

name: Precision Power Analyzer
description_raw: The WT3000E is Yokogawa's precision power analyzer aimed at R&D and standards laboratories that must verify very small efficiency improvements in inverters, motors, drives, lighting, semiconductors and domestic appliances. It offers a basic power accuracy of ±(0.01% of reading + 0.03% of range) with a measurement bandwidth of DC and 0.1 Hz to 1 MHz, and improved accuracy in the 0.1 Hz to 30 Hz region. Up to four power input elements can be installed in one unit, and 30 A and 2 A input elements may be mixed so that standby power and normal operating modes can be tested in a single instrument. Additional functions include delta computation for phase voltage without a neutral line, cycle-by-cycle trend analysis, FFT analysis, saving of raw sampled waveform data and wiring/efficiency compensation. It is also used as a reference standard for periodic in-house calibration of general-purpose power meters such as the WT310E/WT330E series.

description_raw: The WT500 is a compact power analyzer with a 5.7-inch color TFT display for single-phase and three-phase power measurement. It measures voltage, current, power and harmonics simultaneously with a maximum input of 1000 Vrms and 40 Arms, a measurement bandwidth of 100 kHz and a data updating interval of 100 ms to 5 s. With two or more input elements it can measure DC and AC signals at the same time and calculate input-to-output efficiency, making it suited to photovoltaic power conditioners, UPS, inverter-driven motors and home appliance testing. Integration functions cover active power (WP), current (q), reactive power (WQ), apparent power (WS), charge/discharge and bought/sold watt hours, and measured data can be saved directly to USB memory in binary or CSV format.

Harmonic analysis reaches the 500th order with side-by-side comparison of two input sources, and advanced filtering (anti-aliasing, dual line filters, digital parallel path) supports simultaneous wideband and harmonic measurement. A 10.1 inch WXGA resistive touchscreen, hardware hotkeys, up to 32 GB internal memory and multi-unit synchronization of four units (28 elements) target EV powertrain, renewable energy, inverter/motor and appliance testing.

name: GP-IB interface
description_raw: GP-IB communication interface option for the WT500. It conforms electrically and mechanically to IEEE Std 488-1978 (JIS C 1901-1987) and to protocol IEEE Std 488.2-1992, with functional specification SH1, AH1, T6, L4, SR1, RL1, PP0, DC1, DT1 and C0. Addressable mode with addresses 0 to 30 and ISO (ASCII) encoding. Recommended National Instruments cards include AT-GPIB, PCI-GPIB/PCI-GPIB+/PCIe-GPIB and PCMCIA-GPIB/PCMCIA-GPIB+ with driver NI-488.2M version 1.60 or later.

name: Ethernet interface
description_raw: Ethernet communication option for the WT500 with one RJ-45 port conforming to IEEE 802.3. Transmission system is Ethernet 100BASE-TX at max. 100 Mbps using TCP/IP. Supported services are FTP server, DHCP, DNS and remote control (VXI-11).

attributes_raw.supported_services: FTP server, DHCP, DNS, Remote control (VXI-11)

name: External sensor input for 760201
description_raw: External current sensor input option for the one-element WT500 (760201). It adds insulated BNC connector inputs with ranges of 50 mV to 10 V for crest factor 3 (25 mV to 5 V for crest factor 6) and an input impedance of approximately 100 kΩ. The rated voltage to ground of the external current sensor input connector is 600 Vrms. With the /EX option the current input terminals are rated 1000 Vrms maximum measurable voltage (600 Vrms rated per EN61010-2-030).

name: Harmonic Measurement
description_raw: Harmonic measurement option for the WT500, also required for vector, bar graph and trend displays. It uses PLL synchronization with a PLL source fundamental frequency range of 10 Hz to 1.2 kHz, 32-bit FFT data length and a rectangular window; the anti-aliasing filter is set with the line filter (5.5 kHz or OFF). The upper limit of analyzed orders is 50 for fundamentals of 10 Hz to 75 Hz, decreasing to 4 for 600 Hz to 1200 Hz. Harmonic accuracy with the line filter off is 0.15% of reading + 0.35% of range for voltage at 45 Hz to 440 Hz.

attributes_raw.anti_aliasing_filter: Set using a line filter (5.5 kHz or OFF)
attributes_raw.measurement_period: 1024 points at the harmonic sampling frequency from the beginning of the data update interval

name: VGA Output
description_raw: RGB video signal (VGA) output option for the WT500. The output is a 15-pin D-Sub receptacle in VGA compatible format, allowing the instrument screen to be shown on an external monitor.

name: Delta computation
description_raw: Delta calculation option available for the WT500 two- and three-element models (760202/760203). Selectable settings are difference, 3P3W→3V3A, DELTA→STAR and STAR→DELTA for both voltage and current. It computes differential voltage/current, line or phase voltages for 3-phase connections, unmeasured phase currents and neutral line current.

attributes_raw.computed_items: Differential voltage/current, phase/line voltage, neutral line current

name: External sensor input for 760202
description_raw: External current sensor input option for the two-element WT500 (760202). It provides insulated BNC connector inputs with ranges 50 mV to 10 V for crest factor 3 (25 mV to 5 V for crest factor 6) and approximately 100 kΩ input impedance. The external current sensor connector is rated 600 Vrms to ground.

name: Add-on Frequency Measurement
description_raw: Added frequency measurement option for the WT500 two- and three-element models (760202/760203). Without it, up to two voltage or current frequencies can be measured; with /FQ the frequencies of the voltages and currents input to all input elements can be measured (up to 6 channels). Measurement uses the reciprocal method with accuracy ±0.06% of reading, max. display 99999 and minimum frequency resolution 0.0001 Hz. The measurable range depends on the data update rate, from 25 Hz to 100 kHz at 100 ms down to 0.5 Hz to 20 kHz at 5 s.

name: External sensor input for 760203
description_raw: External current sensor input option for the three-element WT500 (760203). It provides insulated BNC connector inputs with ranges 50 mV to 10 V for crest factor 3 (25 mV to 5 V for crest factor 6) and approximately 100 kΩ input impedance. The external current sensor connector is rated 600 Vrms to ground.

name: Voltage Module

It offers 12-bit sampling at up to 100 MS/s, DC to 20 MHz bandwidth and direct input from 1.5 V to 1000 Vrms in 12 ranges. Accuracy from 45 Hz to 1 kHz is ±(0.1% of reading + 0.1% of range). A current module 760812 or 760813 must be ordered together with it, since power values are calibrated with a paired voltage/current module.

attributes_raw.measurement_range: 1.5/3/6/10/15/30/60/100/150/300/600/1000 Vrms (crest factor = 2 at rated range input)
attributes_raw.compatible_with: PX8000; must be ordered together with current module 760812 or 760813

It provides 12-bit sampling at up to 100 MS/s, DC to 10 MHz bandwidth on direct input and DC to 20 MHz on sensor voltage input, with 10 mA to 5 Arms direct ranges and 50 mV to 10 Vrms sensor ranges. Accuracy from 45 Hz to 1 kHz is ±(0.1% of reading + 0.1% of range). Voltage module 760811 must be ordered together with it, and it is required together with the /PD2 option when using a shunt resistor box.

It has 2 channels switchable between analog and pulse input, 12-bit sampling at up to 100 MS/s and DC to 20 MHz bandwidth, accepting up to 200 V (DC+ACpeak) direct or up to 1000 V (DC+ACpeak) via probe. Pulse input covers 2 Hz to 1 MHz and DC accuracy is ±1% of range. Up to three AUX modules can be installed, provided at least one power measurement element is also fitted.

Voltage and current are floating inputs with an 18-bit A/D converter and maximum 100 ns conversion period. Basic accuracy at 45 to 66 Hz is ±(0.01% of reading + 0.02% of range) for voltage, current and active power. The coaxial shunt construction gives low resistance, low inductance and minimal phase shift.

Basic accuracy at 45 to 66 Hz is ±(0.01% of reading + 0.02% of range).

Online synchronization is supported with the DL950 and SL2000. This option is not supported on Windows 11.

name: High-speed Camera Synchronization Option
description_raw: Option that synchronizes high-speed camera images with current, voltage and control signals in IS8000, allowing simultaneous slow-motion playback with the measured waveforms. Online synchronization is supported with Photron FASTCAM SA-Z, Mini UX/AX/WX series, Nova S series and Nova R2 cameras together with the DL950 and SL2000. Video files from non-supported cameras can be imported and played back offline in AVI, MP4, WMV, AVCHD, MOV and MPEG2-PS formats. Pre-trigger and multi-trigger recording with the Mini UX series is not supported.

description_raw: Option enabling simultaneous measurement with Modbus/TCP communication devices in IS8000. Sample communication configuration files for connecting the Yokogawa GM10 and VZ20X recorders are included, and the included tool can create configuration files for other Modbus/TCP devices. It is useful for applications such as air-conditioning equipment development that require many input channels, long recording times and a wide variety of temperature sensors.

name: Waveform Math Option
description_raw: Mathematical data analysis and FFT option for the IS8000 platform, providing inter-channel calculation and frequency-domain analysis. Up to 16 math channels and up to 16 independent FFT channels are available with 59 operator types, digital filters (Gauss, Sharp, IIR Butterworth) and window functions Rect, Hanning, Flat top and Hamming. Computation supports up to 12.5 M points, or up to 100 M points with MATLAB Runtime.

attributes_raw.fft_points: Up to 2 M points, or up to 100 M points with MATLAB Runtime

name: Report Generator Option

name: Serial Bus Analysis Option

The same option provides remote control I/O with EXT START, EXT STOP, EXT RESET, INTEG BUSY, EXT HOLD, EXT SINGLE and EXT PRINT signals at 0 to 5 V. The upper limit of the measured order reaches 500 for U, I, P and phase, and 100 for other measured values. The WT3000E performs the flicker tests itself; combined with the 761922 harmonic/flicker measurement software it can also display trend graphs, cumulative probability (CPF) graphs and reports of dc, dmax and instantaneous flicker sensation (IFS) values.

name: Added Frequency Measurement
description_raw: Option that lets the WT3000E measure the frequency of the voltages and currents input to all input elements using the reciprocal method. The measuring range depends on the data update rate, from 45 Hz ≤ f ≤ 1 MHz at 50 ms down to 0.15 Hz ≤ f ≤ 5 kHz at 20 s. Accuracy is ±0.05% of reading when the input signal levels meet the stated minimum levels (25 mV external current sensor input, 1.5 mA for the 2 A element and 150 mA for the 30 A element direct current input).

attributes_raw.measurement_range: 45 Hz ≤ f ≤ 1 MHz at 50 ms data update rate

name: Advanced Calculation (wide bandwidth harmonic measurement)
description_raw: Advanced calculation option enabling wide bandwidth harmonic measurement on all installed elements of the WT3000E, using either PLL synchronization (fundamental frequency 10 Hz to 2.6 kHz) or an external sampling clock method (3000 times the fundamental frequency, 0.1 Hz to 66 Hz, TTL level). FFT data length is 9000 points with 32-bit processing word length and a rectangular window function; a line filter (OFF, 500 Hz, 5.5 kHz or 50 kHz) serves as anti-aliasing filter. The option is also required for the vector display of the phase difference of the fundamental waves and for the harmonic bar graph display.

attributes_raw.pll_frequency_range: 10 Hz to 2.6 kHz (fundamental frequency of PLL source)
attributes_raw.external_sampling_clock: 3000 × fundamental frequency, 0.1 Hz to 66 Hz, TTL level
attributes_raw.anti_aliasing_filter: Line filter (OFF, 500 Hz, 5.5 kHz, or 50 kHz)

name: Motor Evaluation Function
description_raw: Option that adds motor evaluation to the WT3000E, computing rotating speed, torque, synchronous speed, slip and motor output Pm from revolution and torque sensor signals. Analog (DC voltage) inputs accept 1 V, 2 V, 5 V, 10 V or 20 V ranges via insulated BNC connectors with an accuracy of ±(0.1% of reading + 0.1% of range). Pulse inputs cover 2 Hz to 200 kHz with an accuracy of ±(0.05% of reading + 1 mHz). Torque and revolution-speed waveforms can also be shown on the waveform display.

name: RGB Video Signal (VGA) Output
description_raw: Option adding an RGB video signal output section to the WT3000E for displaying the instrument screen on an external monitor. The connector is a 15-pin D-Sub receptacle and the output format is VGA compatible.

name: Built-in Printer
description_raw: Built-in thermal printer option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers, used for printing screen images such as flicker measurement results. Printer roll paper is provided only with the /B5 option; replacement paper is model B9316FX. When the printer is used the operating humidity range is 35 to 80% RH, and maximum power consumption is 150 VA.

attributes_raw.consumable: B9316FX printer roll paper, thermal paper, 10 meters

name: USB Port (PC)
description_raw: USB device port option for connecting a WT3000E precision power analyzer to a PC for remote control. It provides one Type B receptacle conforming to USB Rev.1.1 at a maximum of 12 Mbps, and works with PCs running Windows Vista, Windows 7 or Windows 8/8.1 with a standard USB port (a separate device driver is required). Only one of /C12 and /C2 (RS-232) can be selected.

relations_raw.note: Only one of /C12 and /C2 can be selected

name: Serial (RS-232) Interface
description_raw: Serial RS-232 communication interface option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers. It uses a 9-pin D-Sub (plug) connector conforming to EIA-574 (EIA-232 for 9 pin), point-to-point full-duplex start-stop synchronization, with baud rates of 1200, 2400, 4800, 9600, 19200 or 38400 bps. Only one of /C2 and /C12 (USB port for PC) can be selected.

relations_raw.note: Only one of /C2 and /C12 can be selected

name: USB Port (Peripheral)
description_raw: USB peripheral port option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers, providing two Type A receptacles conforming to USB Rev.1.1 at up to 12 Mbps. It supports USB HID Class Ver.1.1 keyboards (104 US and 109 Japanese) and USB flash memory, and is required for saving waveform sampling data to USB memory. Power supply is 5 V, 500 mA per port, but devices drawing more than 100 mA cannot be connected to both ports simultaneously.

name: Ethernet Interface
description_raw: Ethernet communication option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers, with one RJ-45 port conforming to IEEE 802.3. It supports 100BASE-TX/10BASE-T at 10 Mbps/100 Mbps using TCP/IP. Supported services are FTP server, FTP client (network drive), LPR client (network printer), SMTP client (mail transmission), Web server, DHCP, DNS and remote control.

attributes_raw.supported_services: FTP server, FTP client, LPR client, SMTP client, Web server, DHCP, DNS, Remote control

name: 20 ch DA Output
description_raw: 20-channel D/A output option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers, allowing measured values to be output as analog signals. A connector is supplied as a standard accessory only when the /DA option is ordered. The matching output connector is the D-Sub 9-pin B8200JQ.

name: Voltage Fluctuation/Flicker
description_raw: Voltage fluctuation and flicker measurement option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers, implementing a class F2 flicker meter. Normal flicker mode measures dc, dmax, d(t)/Tmax, Pst and Plt with observation periods of 30 s to 15 min and 1 to 99 observation period counts; a separate mode measures dmax caused by manual switching over 24 one-minute periods. Target voltage/frequency settings are 230 V/50 Hz, 120 V/60 Hz, 230 V/60 Hz and 120 V/50 Hz, with accuracy ±4% for dc and dmax (at dmax = 4%) and ±5% for Pst (at Pst = 1). Only voltage inputs can be used as the measured source.

name: Add-On Frequency Measurement
description_raw: Add-on frequency measurement option listed in the WT3000E model and suffix code table. It extends the frequency measurement capability of the precision power analyzer. The brochure gives no further specification for this option.

name: Advanced Calculation
description_raw: Advanced computation option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers. On models with /G6, harmonic measurement in normal measurement mode covers PLL source fundamental frequencies from 10 Hz to 2600 Hz with sample rates from f × 3000 down to f × 60 and measured orders up to the 100th. With the line filter off, harmonic voltage and current accuracy is 0.1% of reading + 0.15% of range from 30 Hz to 440 Hz and power accuracy 0.2% of reading + 0.15% of range.

attributes_raw.harmonic_accuracy_filter_off: Voltage and current 0.1% of reading + 0.15% of range (30 Hz ≤ f ≤ 440 Hz)

name: Motor Evaluation Function
description_raw: Motor evaluation option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers. It adds analog torque and speed inputs whose signals can be used as sources for the MATH waveform computation, for FFT analysis and for motor output calculation. A safety BNC cable (761902 series) is used to connect the motor evaluation function to a torque sensor.

attributes_raw.usable_in: MATH computation, FFT computation, waveform sampling data saving

name: VGA Output
description_raw: VGA video output option for the WT3000E precision power analyzers, used to show the instrument screen on an external monitor. It is listed in the option section of the model and suffix code table. No further specification is given in the brochure.

name: Ethernet option
description_raw: Ethernet communication option for the WT300E series. It adds the Modbus/TCP function used to acquire measured data directly with Yokogawa recorders (GP10, GM) and the GA10 data logging software, and supports connection to the FA-M3V PLC via VXI-11 protocol. Modbus/TCP communication with this option allows saving and monitoring of measurement results for up to 200 channels.

attributes_raw.function: Ethernet interface incl. Modbus/TCP function
attributes_raw.max_channels: up to a maximum of 200 channels

name: D/A output (4 CH)
description_raw: Four-channel D/A output option for the WT310E and WT310EH, delivering ±5 V FS (approx. ±7.5 V maximum) against each rated value with 16-bit resolution. Output items are set per channel from U, I, P, S, Q, λ, Φ, fU, fI, Upk, Ipk, WP, WP±, q, q± and MATH; accuracy is ±(accuracy of each measurement item + 0.2% of FS). The option also provides remote control input/output signals (EXT HOLD, EXT TRIG, EXT START, EXT STOP, EXT RESET and INTEG BUSY) at TTL level with negative logic. A connector is supplied with the option.

attributes_raw.accuracy: ±(accuracy of each measurement item + 0.2% of FS) (FS = 5 V)
attributes_raw.remote_control_io: EXT HOLD, EXT TRIG, EXT START, EXT STOP, EXT RESET / INTEG BUSY, TTL

name: External current sensor input (2.5/5/10 V)
description_raw: Isolated BNC external current sensor input option for the WT300E series, used with clamp or shunt sensors that output a voltage. Ranges are 2.5 V/5 V/10 V at crest factor 3 and 1.25 V/2.5 V/5 V at crest factor 6 or 6A, with an input resistance of approximately 100 kΩ. Instantaneous maximum allowable input is a peak value up to 10 times the rated range, and the temperature influence after zero-level compensation is 1 mV/°C.

name: External current sensor input (50 mV to 2 V)
description_raw: Low-level isolated BNC external current sensor input option for the WT300E series. Ranges are 50 mV/100 mV/200 mV/500 mV/1 V/2 V at crest factor 3 and 25 mV/50 mV/100 mV/250 mV/500 mV/1 V at crest factor 6 or 6A, with an input resistance of approximately 20 kΩ. The temperature influence after zero-level compensation or range change is 50 µV/°C, and the maximum rated range for common mode calculations is 2 V.

name: Harmonics Measurement
description_raw: Harmonic measurement option for the WT300E series using the PLL synchronization method on all installed elements. The PLL source fundamental frequency range is 10 Hz to 1.2 kHz with an FFT data length of 1024 and a rectangular window; the upper limit of analysis orders is 50 for 10–75 Hz fundamentals. Accuracy at 45 Hz ≤ f ≤ 440 Hz is ±(0.15% of reading + 0.35% of range) for voltage and current and ±(0.25% of reading + 0.50% of range) for power. Displayed harmonic items include Uhdf, Ihdf, Phdf, Uthd, Ithd and phase angles.

relations_raw.note: Required together with PCM software for IEC62301 testing

name: D/A output (12 CH)
description_raw: Twelve-channel D/A output option for the WT332E and WT333E, delivering ±5 V FS (approx. ±7.5 V maximum) against each rated value with 16-bit D/A conversion resolution. Output items are selectable per channel from U, I, P, S, Q, λ, Φ, fU, fI, Upk, Ipk, WP, WP±, q, q± and MATH, with a minimum load of 100 kΩ. It also adds remote control input/output signals (EXT HOLD, EXT TRIG, EXT START, EXT STOP, EXT RESET and INTEG BUSY) at TTL level. A connector is supplied with the option.

attributes_raw.accuracy: ±(accuracy of each measurement item + 0.2% of FS) (FS = 5 V)
attributes_raw.remote_control_io: EXT HOLD, EXT TRIG, EXT START, EXT STOP, EXT RESET / INTEG BUSY, TTL

name: Harmonic measurement option
description_raw: Option required on the WT332E/WT333E three-phase power meters to enable harmonic measurement. The document states that a maximum of 3 channels of simultaneous harmonic measurement needs the /G5 option. No further details are given in this brochure.

attributes_raw.function: Max. 3 channels simultaneous Harmonic measurement

name: GP-IB Communication
description_raw: GP-IB communication interface option for the WT500. It enables the instrument to be controlled from a PC or measurement data to be transferred to a PC. It is one of the communication interfaces supported by the WTViewerE software.

name: Ethernet Communication
description_raw: Ethernet communication option (100BASE-TX port) for the WT500. Data can be transferred via Ethernet communication and files can be transferred using an FTP server. It is one of the communication interfaces supported by the WTViewerE software.

name: Delta Computation
description_raw: Option for the WT500 that calculates individual phase voltages and phase currents from the line voltages and phase currents measured in a three-phase, three-wire system. It is useful for determining the phase voltage in a DUT with no neutral line using the three-phase, three-wire (3V3A) method. According to the document this function cannot be installed on products with only one element.

attributes_raw.restriction: Cannot be installed on products with only one element

name: External Current Sensor Input
description_raw: External current sensor input option for the WT500, listed in the brochure as /EX1, /EX2 and /EX3. It allows current to be measured with voltage-output current clamps without disconnecting the power supply wiring, and various clamp-on probe types are supported by setting an external current sensor conversion ratio. The external sensor range is 0.05 to 10 V.

name: External Current Sensor Input
description_raw: External current sensor input option for the WT500, listed in the brochure as /EX1, /EX2 and /EX3. Current can be measured using voltage-output current clamps without disconnecting the power supply wiring, and various clamp-on probes are supported by setting an external current sensor conversion ratio. The external sensor range is 0.05 to 10 V.

name: External Current Sensor Input
description_raw: External current sensor input option for the WT500, listed in the brochure as /EX1, /EX2 and /EX3. It enables current measurement with voltage-output current clamps without disconnecting the power supply wiring, supporting various clamp-on probe types via a settable external current sensor conversion ratio. The external sensor range is 0.05 to 10 V.

name: Added Frequency Measurement
description_raw: Option that extends the WT500's standard two channels of frequency measurement to frequency measurement on all channels. It provides frequency measurement of voltage and current on all channels with input elements 1 through 3 installed, allowing several items under test to be measured at the same time. The document states this function cannot be installed on products with only one input element.

attributes_raw.restriction: Cannot be installed on products with only one input element

name: Harmonic Measurement
description_raw: Option for the WT500 that enables simultaneous measurement of normal and harmonic data. Harmonic components of up to the 50th order can be measured, and voltage, current and distortion factor (THD) can be confirmed at the same time without switching modes. This option is also required for the bar graph and vector display formats.

name: VGA Output
description_raw: VGA output option for the WT500. Connecting an external monitor allows large displays of numerical values and waveforms. It is convenient for confirming data on multiple monitors simultaneously or for checking data remotely.

name: Additional option license
description_raw: Separately sold, customer-installable license product that adds WT5000 options after purchase. Suffix -DS adds Data Streaming and suffix -G7 adds IEC Harmonic/Flicker Measurement.

attributes_raw.suffix_codes: -DS Data Streaming, -G7 IEC Harmonic/Flicker Measurement

name: 20 CH D/A Output
description_raw: Option providing 20 channels of D/A output on the WT5000. A connector is supplied as a standard accessory when this option is installed. Only one of /DA20 and /MTR2 can be selected.

name: Data Streaming
description_raw: Option that enables streaming of raw waveform data from the WT5000 to a PC at a sample rate of up to 2 MS/s. Voltage, current and motor signals are streamed without gaps and are synchronized with the numerical data, so transient behaviour can be studied while efficiency or energy consumption is measured. Streaming is done via IS8000 or through dedicated communication commands; the number of traces depends on the interface and sample rate (e.g. 2 MS/s: 2 traces over USB 3.0 or Gigabit Ethernet, 10 k to 200 k S/s: 22 traces).

relations_raw.note: IS8000 can be used to stream the raw waveform data to a PC

name: IEC Harmonic/Flicker Measurement
description_raw: Option that lets the WT5000 perform IEC regulation tests for harmonics and for voltage fluctuation/flicker. Combined with the IS8011/IS8012 Harmonic Flicker software the measured harmonic data is saved to a PC and judged against IEC limits; flicker testing per IEC61000-3-3 shows trends of dc, dmax and Pinst and generates a comprehensive test report. Supported standards include EN/IEC61000-3-2, EN/IEC61000-3-12, JIS C 61000-3-2, EN/IEC61000-3-3 and EN/IEC61000-3-11. For equipment over 16 A/phase the CT200 current sensor can be used; the 760901/760902 elements are available for these tests.

attributes_raw.compatible_with: WT5000; 760901/760902 elements; CT200 for over 16 A/phase

name: 32 GB Built-in Memory
description_raw: Option that expands the WT5000 internal non-volatile memory from the standard 2 GB to 32 GB. The memory stores and recalls custom configurations and test setups and logs large amounts of measurement data over long periods, so the instrument can be used like a data logger without external media. Waveform, numeric, screen copy data and setting information can be saved.

name: Motor Evaluation 1
description_raw: Motor evaluation input option for the WT5000. It can be configured either as one set of Torque (Pulse/Analog) plus A/B/Z (Pulse) inputs, or as two sets of Torque (Pulse/Analog) plus A (Pulse) inputs. It enables measurement of rotational speed and direction, synchronous speed, slip, torque, mechanical power, electrical angle and motor efficiency from analog or pulse outputs of torque and rotation sensors.

attributes_raw.input_configuration: Torque (Pulse/Analog) and A/B/Z (Pulse), or two sets of Torque (Pulse/Analog) and A (Pulse)
attributes_raw.measured_parameters: Rotation speed and direction, synchronous speed, slip, torque, mechanical power, electrical angle, motor efficiency

name: Motor Evaluation 2
description_raw: Second motor evaluation input option for the WT5000, with the same input choices as /MTR1: Torque (Pulse/Analog) plus A/B/Z (Pulse), or two sets of Torque (Pulse/Analog) plus A (Pulse). Used together with /MTR1 it allows one WT5000 to measure up to two motors including rotation direction and electrical angle, or up to four torque and rotation sensors simultaneously. /MTR2 requires installation of /MTR1, and only one of /DA20 and /MTR2 can be selected.

attributes_raw.input_configuration: Torque (Pulse/Analog) and A/B/Z (Pulse), or two sets of Torque (Pulse/Analog) and A (Pulse)

name: Precision DC Calibrator
description_raw: The 2553A is a precision DC calibrator for calibrating measurement instruments including analog meters, thermometers, temperature transmitters and data loggers. It generates DC voltage (10 mV to 30 V ranges), DC current (1 mA to 100 mA ranges), 10 IEC-regulated thermocouple types, Pt100 RTD and 400 Ω resistance, with 5.5-digit ±120000-count output resolution. Operation uses a dial per digit with 7-segment LEDs, and user-defined thermocouple/RTD tables can be loaded as text files by drag & drop over USB. Its communication commands are backwardly compatible with the previous 2553 model, so 2553A and 2553 units can be mixed in the same system.

description_raw: Previous-generation AC voltage and current standard referenced in the 2558A comparison table. It outputs 1.00 mV to 1200.0 V AC and 1.00 mA to 60.00 A AC with ±950 ppm accuracy at 50/60 Hz, specified at fixed frequencies of 50/60/400 Hz, and a 40 to 500 Hz frequency output with ±1% accuracy. The 2558A supports a 2558 command mode so existing 2558 programs can be reused and both models can be mixed in the same system.

name: AC Voltage Current Standard
description_raw: Standalone AC voltage and current source for calibrating analog meters, clamp meters and current transformers. It outputs 1.00 mV to 1200.0 V AC and 1.00 mA to 60.00 A AC (up to 1440 V and 72 A when the deviation function is used) over a 40 to 1000 Hz frequency range, with a dedicated dial for each function and digit and 7-segment LED readout of the actual output. Functions such as output divider, deviation with preset, and 8/16/32/64 s sweep of voltage, current or frequency are provided specifically for meter calibration and needle-sticking tests. Multiple units can be synchronized via the internal phase shifter to build single- or three-phase power calibration systems, or connected in parallel to double the current output to 144 A at 50/60 Hz.

Main setting is 4.5 digits with 3 dials, thermocouple types R, J, T, E and K are supported, and GP-IB is available as an option. It weighs approximately 34 kg.

name: Precision DC Calibrator

It generates DC voltage from −1224.00 V to +1224.00 V and DC current from −12.2400 A to +36.720 A, with a maximum output of ±122.4% of range so that a 1200 V instrument range can be calibrated. Accuracy is ±50 ppm for DC voltage and ±70 ppm for DC current (1 V and 1 mA range, 180 days), with 5.5-digit display (6.5 digits in high resolution mode). Dedicated dials per digit and function, sweep, output divider, scale setting and deviation functions support analog meter calibration, while USB, Ethernet and GP-IB interfaces allow control from an ATE system. Thermocouple emf (10 IEC types), Pt100 RTD temperature and resistance from 1 to 400 Ω can also be generated, with internal, external or manual reference junction compensation.

name: Multi-function Process Calibrator
description_raw: The CA500 is a handheld multi-function process calibrator that sources and measures DC voltage, DC current, RTD, thermocouple, resistance, frequency and pulse signals for field instrument calibration. Basic accuracy is 0.015% for DC current, 0.020% for resistance and 0.3 °C for RTD. It has a reflective monochrome dot-matrix LCD with main and sub displays, a wiring-information display, LINEAR/SQUARE ROOT output for 4-20 mA and 1-5 V ranges, and step, linear and program sweep functions (10 steps for CA500). It runs on four AA alkaline batteries or USB power (2WAY power supply) with a battery life of approximately 16 hours and stores up to 100 measurement results.

It sources DC voltage, DC current, resistance, TC, RTD, frequency and pulse signals while simultaneously measuring DC voltage, DC current, resistance, AC voltage, frequency and pulse. Functions include 24 V DC transmitter supply, divided output (n/m), auto-step, sweep, and memory for 50 value sets. Housing and general specifications match the CA71: approximately 190 × 120 × 55 mm and about 680 g including batteries; the terminal adapter 99021 is not used on the CA51.

description_raw: The CA550 is the higher-accuracy model of the CA500 series multi-function process calibrator, with 0.010% DC current, 0.015% resistance and 0.1 °C RTD basic accuracy. It adds automatic input/output testing via program sweep with up to 20 steps and saves calibration results (source value, measured value, error rate, date/time, pass/fail) as CSV files (up to 250) that can be transferred to a PC over USB mass storage. With suffix -F2 or -F3 it supports HART communication (reading TagNo/PV, reading and writing LRV/URV and damping, D/A trim at 4 and 20 mA, PV Zero); the -F2 model additionally provides BRAIN TagNo acquisition. It sources and measures DC voltage, DC current, RTD (14 standards), TC (17 standards), resistance, frequency and pulse, and runs approximately 16 hours on four AA alkaline batteries or from USB.

name: Pressure Calibrator

It uses a silicon resonant pressure sensor to achieve 0.01% of reading pressure measurement accuracy and 0.015% of reading for current and voltage source/measurement, with a resolution of 0.001 kPa in the 200 kPa range. Embedded calibration procedures for pressure transmitters and pressure switches record As Found/As Left data and error rate, which can be saved to USB memory or transferred to a PC. The IP54 dustproof and waterproof case, tilt stand and shoulder strap make it suitable for harsh field environments. Three gauge pressure models are available (200 kPa, 1000 kPa and 3500 kPa) and the optional external sensor PM100 extends measurement up to 70 MPa.

name: Handy Calibrator
description_raw: The CA71 is a small, lightweight multifunction handy calibrator that can source and measure signals at the same time, covering DC voltage, DC current, resistance, thermocouple, RTD, frequency and pulse. It also measures AC voltage up to 300 V, so supply voltage of rack- or panel-mounted converters can be checked without a separate multimeter. Additional functions include 24 V DC transmitter power supply, divided output (n/m), auto-step, sweep (16 or 32 s), memory for 50 value sets, temperature monitor and an RS-232C-compliant optically isolated interface (CA71 only). Operation is by rotary switches; the unit measures approximately 190 x 120 x 55 mm and weighs about 680 g including batteries.

name: AC Power Calibrator
description_raw: The LS3300 is a single-phase AC power calibrator that generates highly accurate and stable AC voltage, current and power for calibrating power meters, power transducers, clamp-on power meters, power monitors and analog instruments. It delivers ±350 ppm AC voltage accuracy, ±450 ppm AC current and AC power accuracy (1 year) and a phase accuracy of ±0.03° at 50/60 Hz. A single unit supports 1P2W wiring, while multiple units synchronized over BNC cables support 1P3W, 3P3W and 3P4W, and up to three units in parallel can output as much as 180 A. It has a 5.7-inch color LCD showing wiring, output settings and a phase chart, plus a STABILIZING indication that tells the user when the output has settled.

name: Digital Manometer
description_raw: The MT300 is a digital manometer built around Yokogawa's proprietary silicon resonant sensor, delivering 0.01% relative accuracy with a 12-month accuracy guarantee period. It is available in 13 pressure type/range variants: 6 gauge pressure models (10 kPa to 70 MPa), 3 absolute pressure models (130 kPa to 3500 kPa abs) and 4 differential pressure models (1 kPa to 700 kPa). Functions include leak test, scaling, statistical processing (max/min/average/standard deviation), relative value display, %ERROR, tilt alarm and tilt correction on absolute models, and synchronous measurement of up to 4 daisy-chained units. Options add high-speed measurement modes (/F1), an extra display resolution digit (/R1), D/A and comparator output (/DA), DCV/DCA measurement with 24 VDC transmitter supply (/DM) and battery operation (/EB).

description_raw: Single-channel InGaAs optical power meter module for AQ2300 Series frames, covering 800 to 1700 nm and −90 to +15 dBm (CW). Measurement uncertainty under reference conditions is ±2.5% with ±0.02 dB ±5 pW linearity and a noise level below 5 pW; minimum averaging time is 20 µs. It provides an analog output of approximately 0 to 2 V or 0 to 5 V on a BNC connector and accepts AQ9335C FC, SC, LC or MU connector adapters. It is used for optical transceiver power measurement and insertion loss measurement of optical passive components, and can be trigger-synchronized with source measure unit channels for I-L sweeps.

description_raw: Two-channel InGaAs optical power meter module that occupies a single AQ2300 Series frame slot, allowing up to 18 optical channels in the 9-slot AQ23012A. Applicable fiber is SMF (ITU-T G.652.D) or GI up to 62.5/125 µm, and optical input uses AQ9335C FC, SC, LC or MU connector adapters. Logging (up to 1000000 points) and stability measurements up to 99 days are supported by the frame.

description_raw: Compact handheld OTDR for testing and analyzing access optical networks on single-mode fiber (ITU-T G.652). Built-in power checker and stabilized light source (plus optional visible light source) reduce the number of instruments a field technician must carry. name: Optical Spectrum Analyzer
description_raw: The AQ6360 is a cost-effective diffraction-grating based optical spectrum analyzer optimized for production testing of telecom optical devices such as lasers, optical transceivers and optical amplifiers. It covers 1200 to 1650 nm with wavelength resolution settings of 0.1 to 2 nm, ±0.02 nm wavelength accuracy (1520 to 1580 nm), 55 dB dynamic range and a measurement range of +20 to −80 dBm. Its 4U height is 1U lower than the AQ6370 Series.

description_raw: Removable connector adapter for 1.25 mm diameter ferrules, used with the AQ2170/AQ2170H/AQ2180/AQ2180H optical power meters. The adapter is detachable for easy cleaning.

name: Connector adapter (2.5 mm dia.)
description_raw: Removable connector adapter for 2.5 mm diameter ferrules, used with the AQ2170/AQ2170H/AQ2180/AQ2180H optical power meters. The adapter is detachable for easy cleaning.

name: Connector adapter (FC)
description_raw: Removable FC connector adapter for the AQ4280A/AQ4280B/AQ4280C optical light sources. The adapter can be detached for easy cleaning of the optical output.

name: Connector adapter (SC)
description_raw: Removable SC connector adapter for the AQ4280A/AQ4280B/AQ4280C optical light sources. The adapter is detachable for easy cleaning.

name: Connector adapter (ST)
description_raw: Removable ST connector adapter for the AQ4280A/AQ4280B/AQ4280C optical light sources. The adapter is detachable for easy cleaning.

name: Slit sleeve
description_raw: Slit sleeve for the AQ4280A/AQ4280B/AQ4280C optical light sources.

name: USB cable for DC power supply
description_raw: USB cable, 1 m long, for DC power supply to the AQ1000. The AQ1000 is charged through its USB port, so no AC adapter needs to be carried; a USB power adapter is not included with the instrument.

name: USB Cable (Type-C to Type-C)
description_raw: USB Type-C to Type-C cable sold separately for the AQ1210 series. The instrument's USB 2.0 Type-C port is used for DC power supply, storage and remote control, for example direct connection to a PC running the AQ7933 remote controller.

name: USB cable (Type-A to Type-C, 1 m)
description_raw: USB cable, Type-A to Type-C, 1 m long, used to connect the AQ3550 Optical Switch Box to an OTDR for power supply and remote control. The Type-A side connects to the OTDR and the Type-C side to the AQ3550. It is supplied as a standard accessory with the AQ3550 and is also available separately.

name: Visible Light Source
description_raw: Option that adds a visible red light source port to the AQ1000 for checking continuity of launch fibers or short fiber trunks. Breaks and bends in the fiber can be identified visually. The source emits at 650 ±20 nm with an optical output level of –3 dBm or more (peak) and supports CW and 2 Hz modulation. It is classified as Laser Class 3R.

name: Wireless LAN
description_raw: Wireless LAN option (IEEE802.11b/g/n) for the AQ1000, enabling data transfer and remote control together with wireless LAN capable devices. With this option data files can be sent to a smartphone or tablet using the OTDR Data Transporter, or to a PC using the OTDR Remote Controller software, and the instrument can be operated remotely from a web browser. Use of wireless LAN is subject to the regulations of each country. Operating temperature when using WLAN is 0 to 50°C.

name: Optical connector SC/Angled-PC type (except AQ1100D)
description_raw: Optical connector suffix giving SC/Angled-PC type on the light source port and on the optical power meter port when the PON power meter (-PPM) is ordered; with -SPM or -HPM the OPM port is SC type. This option is not available for the AQ1100D.

attributes_raw.connector_type: SC/Angled-PC (LS port, OPM port for -PPM), SC (OPM port for -SPM and -HPM)

name: High power optical power meter
description_raw: High power built-in optical power meter suffix for the AQ1100 series, covering +27 to −50 dBm (CW) and +24 to −50 dBm (CHOP, except 850 nm and 1650 nm). Noise level is 50 nW (−43 dBm, 1310 nm) with ±5% uncertainty under standard conditions on GI (50/125 µm) fiber. Wavelength setting covers simple, detail (800 to 1700 nm, 1 nm step) and CWDM (1270 to 1610 nm, 20 nm step) modes. Loss test modes are supported with this power meter.

name: PON optical power meter (AQ1100A only)
description_raw: PON optical power meter suffix available for the AQ1100A only, measuring 1310/1490/1550 nm where 1490 nm and 1550 nm can be measured separately (parallel measurement). Power range is +27 to −50 dBm at 1550 nm and +10 to −70 dBm at 1310/1490 nm on SM (ITU-G.652) fiber. Noise level is 0.5 nW (−63 dBm, 1310 nm) and 50 nW (−43 dBm, 1550 nm), with ±0.5 dB (10%) uncertainty under standard conditions. Modulation mode is CW only and loss test modes are not offered with this power meter.

name: Optical power meter (standard)
description_raw: Standard built-in optical power meter suffix for the AQ1100 series. Power range is +10 to −70 dBm (CW) and +7 to −70 dBm (CHOP) on SM (ITU-G.652) fiber, with 0.5 nW noise level (−63 dBm, 1310 nm) and ±5% uncertainty under standard conditions. Wavelength setting covers simple mode 850/1300/1310/1490/1550/1625/1650 nm, detail mode 800 to 1700 nm in 1 nm steps and CWDM mode 1270 to 1610 nm in 20 nm steps. Loss test modes (auto loss test, loopback test, multi-core loss test) are available with this power meter.

attributes_raw.logging_function: Intervals 500 ms, 1 s, 2 s, 5 s, 10 s; count 10 to 1000

name: Optical connector FC type (LS port and OPM port)
description_raw: Optical connector suffix specifying FC type connectors on both the light source port and the optical power meter port of the AQ1100 series. It is selected at ordering together with the light source model and power meter type.

name: Optical connector LC type (LS port, and OPM port for -PPM)
description_raw: Optical connector suffix giving LC type on the light source port and on the optical power meter port when the PON power meter (-PPM) is ordered. With the -SPM or -HPM power meters the OPM port is equipped with a 1.25 mm dia. adapter instead.

name: Optical connector SC type (LS port and OPM port)
description_raw: Optical connector suffix specifying SC type connectors on both the light source port and the optical power meter port of the AQ1100 series. It is selected at ordering together with the light source model and power meter type.

name: Alternative AC adapter
description_raw: Alternative AC adapter option for the AQ1100 series, intended for countries that require CE marking.

attributes_raw.purpose: For the countries that require CE marking

name: Ethernet (10/100BASE-TX)
description_raw: Factory installed LAN interface for the AQ1100 series with 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX and RJ-45 connector. It enables the PING test function and PC remote control of the instrument.

name: Shoulder belt
description_raw: Factory installed shoulder belt option for the AQ1100 series for hands-free carrying in the field.

name: Visible light source
description_raw: Factory installed visible light source for the AQ1100 series used for fiber identification and fault location. It emits 650 nm ±20 nm with a peak output level of −3 dBm or more through a 2.5 mm dia. ferrule type optical connector. Modulation mode is CHOP 2 Hz and the source is laser Class 3R.

attributes_raw.optical_connector: 2.5 mm dia. ferrule type

name: Additional Option License
description_raw: Separately sold additional option license for the AQ1210 series, listed with suffix -FST for the Fiber Surface Test function. It enables the automatic analysis of connector end face scratches and dirt with PASS/FAIL judgment. It is offered in the accessories (sold separately) table of the brochure.

attributes_raw.suffix_codes: -FST Fiber Surface Test function

name: Fiber Surface Test function (pass/fail judgment)
description_raw: Option that automatically analyses scratches and dirt on fiber connector end faces and gives a PASS/FAIL judgment based on IEC61300-3-35 compatible or arbitrary criteria. The surface image can be saved and the judgment results output to a PDF report. A recommended optical fiber inspection probe is required, and this function cannot be used in multi-tasking mode.

attributes_raw.judgment_criteria: IEC61300-3-35 compatible or arbitrary decision criteria
attributes_raw.requirement: /FST option and a recommended optical fiber inspection probe

name: High power optical power meter
description_raw: Built-in high power optical power meter option for the AQ1210, intended for video services such as CATV and for long distance links using optical amplifiers. Wavelength setting range is 800 to 1700 nm with a CW power range of −50 to +27 dBm (−50 to +24 dBm in CHOP). It supports auto loss test and multi-fiber loss test with a second AQ1210. The option cannot be added after shipping.

attributes_raw.functions: Auto loss test, multi-fiber loss test

name: Power Checker (integrated optical power meter)
description_raw: Basic optical power meter integrated into OTDR port 1, useful for checking optical power before an OTDR measurement without changing ports. Supported wavelengths are 1310/1490/1550/1625/1650 nm with a power range of −50 to −5 dBm and uncertainty ±0.5 dB. It works only on port 1 and does not support 850/1300 nm. The option cannot be added after shipping.

attributes_raw.port: OTDR Port 1, not applicable to Port 2

name: PON optical power meter
description_raw: Built-in PON optical power meter option that measures optical power at 1490 nm and 1550 nm simultaneously by separating the wavelengths. Selectable wavelengths are 1310/1490/1550 nm, with a power range of −70 to +10 dBm at 1310/1490 nm and −50 to +27 dBm at 1550 nm. Uncertainty is ≤±5% and readout resolution 0.01 dB. The option cannot be added after shipping.

name: Shoulder Belt
description_raw: Shoulder belt option ordered with the AQ1210 series OTDR. It is listed in the model and suffix code table as option /SB. The corresponding separately sold accessory is the B8070CY shoulder belt.

name: Standard optical power meter
description_raw: Built-in standard optical power meter on a dedicated port of the AQ1210, usable together with the standard light source function for loss measurement. Wavelength can be set from 800 to 1700 nm in 1 nm increments, with a CW power range of −70 to +10 dBm and −70 to +7 dBm in CHOP mode. It supports modulated signal measurement, data logging, auto loss test and multi-fiber loss test. The option cannot be added after shipping.

attributes_raw.optical_connector: SC, FC, 2.5 mm diameter ferrule, 1.25 mm diameter ferrule
attributes_raw.functions: Auto loss test, multi-fiber loss test

name: Visible Light Source
description_raw: Visible red laser light source option for checking continuity of patch cords, launch fibers and short fiber trunks, where breaks and bends can be identified visually. Wavelength is 650 ±20 nm with optical output power of −3 dBm or more (peak) and CW or CHOP (approx. 2 Hz) modulation. The output uses a dedicated 2.5 mm diameter ferrule type connector and is Class 3R laser. The option cannot be added after shipping.

attributes_raw.optical_connector: 2.5 mm diameter ferrule type

name: Calibration (calibration certificate is not included)
description_raw: Ordering option for calibration of the AQ2170/AQ2180 power meters and AQ4280 light sources. The calibration certificate itself is not included in this option. The /CAL option is required in order to also order the calibration certificate (model 735993), and the certificate can only be issued at the time of product delivery, not afterwards.

name: Equipped with GP-IB interface
description_raw: GP-IB interface suffix code that equips an AQ2300 Series frame with an IEEE-488 compatible GP-IB port (IEEE-488.2 protocol) for remote control. It is factory-installed and cannot be retrofitted.

name: Digital I/O 8 ports, ExtTrigger I/O 1 port
description_raw: External interface suffix code for AQ2300 Series frames providing an 8-port Digital I/O (CMOS level 5 V/3.3 V, push-in connection plug × 2) together with one external trigger I/O port. The Digital I/O receives operation start signals from external devices and sends operation end signals; among the modules, the source measure unit supports this function. It is factory-installed and cannot be retrofitted.

attributes_raw.digital_io: CMOS level (5 V/3.3 V) × 8 ports, push-in connection plug × 2

name: No Digital I/O, ExtTrigger I/O 2 per port
description_raw: External interface suffix code for AQ2300 Series frames selecting two external trigger I/O ports and no Digital I/O. It is a factory-installed choice that cannot be retrofitted, and it is mutually exclusive with the -EDP Digital I/O configuration.

attributes_raw.interface: ExtTrigger I/O 2 per port, no Digital I/O

name: No GP-IB interface included
description_raw: GP-IB interface suffix code for AQ2300 Series frames specifying that no GP-IB interface is installed. The GP-IB interface is a factory-installed option and cannot be retrofitted later.

name: AQ9335C (FC) Connector Adapter (with a light shielding cap)
description_raw: Spec code for the AQ23211A and AQ23212A optical power meter modules, delivering the module with an AQ9335C FC connector adapter including a light shielding cap. The light shielding cap is used when executing the ZERO-SET of the optical sensor.

name: AQ9335C (LC) Connector Adapter
description_raw: Spec code for the AQ23211A and AQ23212A optical power meter modules, supplying an AQ9335C LC connector adapter for the optical input port.

name: AQ9335C (MU) Connector Adapter
description_raw: Spec code for the AQ23211A and AQ23212A optical power meter modules, supplying an AQ9335C MU connector adapter for the optical input port.

name: No connector adapter
description_raw: Spec code for the AQ23211A and AQ23212A optical power meter modules ordered without any AQ9335C connector adapter. Adapters can then be ordered separately as accessories.

name: AQ9335C (SC) Connector Adapter (with a light shielding cap)
description_raw: Spec code for the AQ23211A and AQ23212A optical power meter modules, supplying an AQ9335C SC connector adapter with a light shielding cap for the optical input port.

name: AQ3550 Optical Switch Box (SC) for SM
description_raw: 12-channel optical switch box for single-mode fiber that works in conjunction with the AQ7280 OTDR. Control and power supply come from the OTDR mainframe via USB, and the switch box enables continuous measurement of all or a selection of the 12 channels under the same conditions. It is useful when measuring multiple fibers such as optical fiber tape, and is available for multi-tasking (but not simultaneously with the fiber surface image display).

relations_raw.note: Controlled and powered from the OTDR mainframe

name: Wavelength reference source (FC connector)
description_raw: Factory option adding a built-in wavelength reference light source with FC connector to the AQ6360, used for wavelength calibration of the instrument. The built-in calibration light source is a Class 1 laser per EN 60825-1 and IEC 60825-1. Wavelength accuracy and linearity specifications apply after wavelength calibration with the built-in reference light source.

name: Wavelength reference source (SC connector)
description_raw: Factory option adding a built-in wavelength reference light source with SC connector to the AQ6360, used for wavelength calibration of the instrument. The built-in calibration light source is a Class 1 laser per EN 60825-1 and IEC 60825-1. Wavelength accuracy and linearity specifications apply after wavelength calibration with the built-in reference light source.

name: AQ9447 (FC) connector adapter for optical input
description_raw: Factory option that equips the AQ6361 optical input port with an AQ9447 FC-type connector adapter. The optical input connector type of the AQ6361 can be changed by using such a connector adapter.

relations_raw.note: Factory option for optical input port

name: 735385 NA conversion adapter (FC)
description_raw: Factory option that adds the 735385 NA conversion adapter with FC connector to the AQ6361. The adapter is connected to GI50 or GI62.5 optical fibers with relatively large NA to improve the stability of light level measurements. It can only be used with the AQ9447 (FC) optical input adapter, and a wavelength resolution setting of 0.2 nm or higher is recommended with GI62.5 and GI50 multi-mode fibers.

name: AQ9441 (FC) connector adapter for calibration output
description_raw: Factory option that equips the AQ6361 calibration light source output port with an AQ9441 FC-type connector adapter. The calibration output is available on the L1 specification only, which includes the built-in wavelength reference source.

relations_raw.note: Factory option for calibration light output port

name: AQ9441 (SC) connector adapter for calibration output
description_raw: Factory option that equips the AQ6361 calibration light source output port with an AQ9441 SC-type connector adapter. The calibration output is available on the L1 specification only, which includes the built-in wavelength reference source.

relations_raw.note: Factory option for calibration light output port

name: AQ9447 (SC) connector adapter for optical input
description_raw: Factory option that equips the AQ6361 optical input port with an AQ9447 SC-type connector adapter. The optical input connector type of the AQ6361 can be changed by using such a connector adapter.

relations_raw.note: Factory option for optical input port

name: AQ9447 (FC) Connector Adapter for optical input
description_raw: Factory installed option that fits an AQ9447 FC-type connector adapter to the optical input port. It is offered for the AQ6370E and AQ6374E, which use a universal optical connector system.
doc_refs: Brochure AQ6370E, AQ6373E, AQ6374E, AQ6375E, AQ6376E, AQ6377E.pdf

name: AQ9441 (FC) Connector Adapter for calibration output
description_raw: Factory installed option that fits an AQ9441 FC-type connector adapter to the calibration output port. It is offered for the AQ6370E and AQ6374E.
doc_refs: Brochure AQ6370E, AQ6373E, AQ6374E, AQ6375E, AQ6376E, AQ6377E.pdf

name: AQ9441 (SC) Connector Adapter for calibration output
description_raw: Factory installed option that fits an AQ9441 SC-type connector adapter to the calibration output port. It is offered for the AQ6370E and AQ6374E.
doc_refs: Brochure AQ6370E, AQ6373E, AQ6374E, AQ6375E, AQ6376E, AQ6377E.pdf

name: AQ9447 (SC) Connector Adapter for optical input
description_raw: Factory installed option that fits an AQ9447 SC-type connector adapter to the optical input port. It is offered for the AQ6370E and AQ6374E.
doc_refs: Brochure AQ6370E, AQ6373E, AQ6374E, AQ6375E, AQ6376E, AQ6377E.pdf

name: Fiber Surface Test function
description_raw: Fiber Surface Test option for the AQ7280 mainframe. It automatically analyzes scratches and dirt on a fiber connector's end face and makes a PASS/FAIL judgment based on IEC 61300-3-35-compatible criteria or user-defined criteria. Surface images and judgment results can be saved and output as PDF reports. A recommended optical fiber inspection probe is required, and this function is not available for multi-tasking.

name: Ethernet
description_raw: Ethernet (10/100BASE-T) interface option for the AQ7280 OTDR mainframe. It enables file transfer and remote control over a wired LAN, so the OTDR can be added to a company network and monitored remotely. Required to use the AQ7940 optical fiber monitoring software over Ethernet.

name: Monitoring function
description_raw: Schedule Measurement (monitoring) option for the AQ7280 mainframe. OTDR measurements are performed automatically at user-defined intervals to detect network connection interruptions caused by intermittent events. The dB value of a fixed point and the loss over a specific section are shown in a logging view for analysis of changes over time; saved trace and logging data can be analyzed later.

attributes_raw.function: Schedule Measurement (Monitoring function)

name: Shoulder Belt
description_raw: Shoulder belt option ordered with the AQ7280 OTDR mainframe. It provides carrying capability for field use. The equivalent part is also available separately as B8070CY.

name: Smart Mapper function
description_raw: Smart Mapper option for the AQ7280 mainframe. With a single button press it executes measurements, detects network events and performs PASS/FAIL judgments against thresholds specified in advance. Results are presented in a simple icon-based map view showing the location and type of events.

attributes_raw.function: Smart Mapper (single-button measurement, event detection, PASS/FAIL judgment)

name: Power Checker (Integrated optical power meter)
description_raw: Power Checker option for AQ7280 OTDR units: an optical power meter integrated on the OTDR port, used to check optical power before making an OTDR measurement without changing ports. Wavelength settings are 1310/1490/1550/1625/1650 nm, power range −50 to −5 dBm and measurement accuracy ±0.5 dB. It is not applicable to AQ7286A, AQ7286H, AQ7286J, nor to port 2 of AQ7283E and AQ7283F.

name: Stabilized Light Source
description_raw: Stabilized Light Source option for AQ7280 OTDR units. It modulates and outputs light at the OTDR wavelength via the OTDR port for optical loss measurement in combination with an OPM module, or as a light source for optical fiber identification. Optical output power is −3 dBm ±1 dB with modulation modes CW, 270 Hz, 1 kHz and 2 kHz. Not applicable to AQ7286A, AQ7286H and AQ7286J; on AQ7284A, AQ7285A and AQ7284H the dynamic range decreases by 0.5 dB.

name: 10 nm Wavelength Tolerance
description_raw: Option that specifies a tighter center wavelength tolerance of ±10 nm for the research and manufacturing OTDR units. It is used to meet the stringent standards compliant with IEC 60793-1-40. Applicable to AQ7286A, AQ7286H and AQ7286J only (1383 nm remains ±2 nm).

name: Additional option license for AQ7290
description_raw: Additional option license that can be added to an AQ7290 series OTDR after purchase. Suffix -MNT enables the monitoring (schedule measurement) function and suffix -FST enables the fiber surface test function.

attributes_raw.suffix_codes: -MNT Monitoring function, -FST Fiber surface test function

name: Fiber surface test function
description_raw: Option that automatically analyses scratches and dirt on the fiber end face and makes a PASS/FAIL judgement based on IEC 61300-3-35-compatible criteria or user-defined criteria. Surface images and judgement results can be saved and output as PDF reports. A recommended optical fiber inspection probe is required, and the function is not available for multi-tasking.

attributes_raw.requirement: Recommended optical fiber inspection probe required; not available for multi-tasking

name: High power optical power meter
description_raw: High-power optical power meter option for the AQ7290 series covering wavelength settings from 800 to 1700 nm. The specification table lists a CW power range of +27 dBm to −70 dBm and a CHOP range of +24 dBm to −50 dBm in the 1300 to 1600 nm range; noise level is 50 nW (−43 dBm, 1310 nm). Uncertainty is ±5 % with 0.01 dB readout resolution, and it supports logging and file saving like the standard power meter.

name: Ethernet
description_raw: Ethernet interface option for the AQ7290 series, adding one 1000BASE-T port. The Ethernet port can be used for file transfer and for remote control of the instrument.

attributes_raw.function: File transfer and remote control

The dB value of a fixed point and the loss over a specific section are shown in a logging view, and saved trace and logging graph data can be analysed later.

attributes_raw.function: Schedule measurement (monitoring)

name: Integrated optical power meter (Power checker)
description_raw: Power checker option that performs simple optical power measurement through the OTDR port, so optical power and OTDR measurement can be done continuously without changing fibers. Wavelength settings are 1310/1490/1550/1625/1650 nm with a power range of −50 to −5 dBm and measurement accuracy of ±0.5 dB. It is not applicable to port 2 of the AQ7293F.

attributes_raw.compatible_with: AQ7290 series; not applicable to port 2 of AQ7293F

name: Shoulder belt
description_raw: Shoulder belt option ordered with the AQ7290 series OTDR main frame for field carrying. The same item is also available separately as model B8070CY.

name: Standard optical power meter
description_raw: Built-in standard optical power meter option for the AQ7290 series, used with a stabilized light source for loss measurement. Wavelength settings cover 800 to 1700 nm with a CW power range of +10 dBm to −70 dBm and a CHOP range of +7 dBm to −70 dBm. Noise level is 0.5 nW (−63 dBm, 1310 nm), uncertainty ±5 % and readout resolution 0.01 dB, with data logging and saving of 100 data per file.

attributes_raw.optical_connector: SC, FC, 2.5 mm diameter ferrule, 1.25 mm diameter ferrule

name: Visible light source
description_raw: Visible red light source option used to check continuity of patch cords, launch fibers and short fiber trunks, making breaks and bends visible at fault points. Wavelength is 650 ±20 nm with an optical output power of −3 dBm or more (peak) and CW/CHOP (approx. 2 Hz) modulation, laser class 3R. It uses a separate port from the OTDR/OPM, so another fiber can be searched while the OTDR or power meter is in use.

name: Sensor Head
description_raw: The AQ740023 is a dedicated sensor head driven and controlled by the AQ7420 or AQ7421 High-Resolution Reflectometer, enabling insertion loss measurement in addition to return loss in a single operation. It covers 1310 nm/1550 nm, an insertion loss measurement range of 0 to 10 dB and an insertion loss measurement uncertainty of ±0.02 dB (2σ). It is supplied with an FC or SC connector adapter, and optional AQ740081 adapters allow LC, MT, MPO connectors, 2.5 and 1.25 dia. ferrules and a fiber holder. Power is supplied by the reflectometer, and the unit measures 60 × 45 × 100 mm and approx. 0.4 kg.

attributes_raw.power: Supplied by AQ7420 or AQ7421 High-Resolution Reflectometer
attributes_raw.suffix_codes: -FCC AQ740081 Connector Adapter (FC), -SCC AQ740081 Connector Adapter (SC), -L1 cable length 1 m, -L2 cable length 2 m

name: Multi Switch Unit
description_raw: The AQ740027 Multi Switch Unit is driven and controlled by the AQ7420 or AQ7421 and enables automatic measurement of up to 24 fibers. It provides maximum 24 channels with approx. 2 second channel switching, insertion loss of 2.6 dB or less and CH switching repeatability of ±0.02 dB. The measurement port is FC/Angled PC and there are 24 LC/Angled PC output ports, with a maximum input level of 17 dBm. Power comes from the reflectometer; the unit is 200 × 132 × 350 mm and approx. 3.0 kg.

attributes_raw.dimensions_and_mass: 200 (W) × 132 (H) × 350 (D) mm (excluding protector and handle), approx. 3.0 kg
attributes_raw.power: Supplied by AQ7420 or AQ7421 High-Resolution Reflectometer

name: Expander Unit
description_raw: The AQ740051 Expander Unit is driven and controlled by the AQ7421 only and extends the measurement distance up to 8 m for fault location in short fiber assemblies and integrated photonic devices. It offers maximum 8 channels (CH1 fixed for the 0 to 1000 mm range), approx. 2 second switching, insertion loss of 4.8 dB or less and CH switching repeatability of ±0.04 dB. It has 14 SC/Angled PC expansion ports and 2 SC/Angled PC reference ports. Power is supplied by the AQ7421; dimensions are 200 × 132 × 350 mm, approx. 3.0 kg.

attributes_raw.dimensions_and_mass: 200 (W) × 132 (H) × 350 (D) mm (excluding protector and handle), approx. 3.0 kg

name: Connector Adapter
description_raw: The AQ740081 Connector Adapter is mounted on the AQ740023 Sensor Head to support different test interfaces. Available suffix codes cover FC, SC and LC connectors, 1.25 mm and 2.5 mm diameter ferrules, MT and MPO connectors, and a fiber holder. This flexibility allows the AQ7420/AQ7421 measurement system to be adapted to different device-under-test setups.

attributes_raw.suffix_codes: -FCC FC connector, -SCC SC connector, -LCC LC connector, -LMC Ferrule (1.25 diameter), -SFC Ferrule (2.5 diameter), -MTC MT connector, -MPC MPO connector, -FHC Fiber holder

name: Master Cord (for AQ7420/AQ7421)
description_raw: The AQ740091 is the master cord used with the AQ7420 and AQ7421 High-Resolution Reflectometers; it can also be ordered together with the instrument via the -FCM or -SCM suffix. Connector options include FC/Angled PC, FC, SC, LC and MU master connectors, with PC or Angled PC polish.

name: Master Cord (for AQ740027)
description_raw: The AQ740092 is the master cord for the AQ740027 Multi Switch Unit. It is available in 12-fiber and 24-fiber versions with MPO connectors and Angled PC or PC polish options.

name: Distance Adjustment Cord (for AQ740027)
description_raw: The AQ740095 Distance Adjustment Cord is used with the AQ740027 Multi Switch Unit to adjust the starting position of the measurement. It is available in lengths of 0, 500, 1000, 1500 and 2000 mm; other lengths can be requested from Yokogawa sales.

attributes_raw.function: Adjusts the starting position of the measurement

name: Distance Adjustment Cord (for AQ7420/AQ7421)
description_raw: The AQ740096 Distance Adjustment Cord is used with the AQ7420 and AQ7421 High-Resolution Reflectometers to adjust the starting position of the measurement. Lengths of 0, 500, 1000, 1500 and 2000 mm are listed; other lengths are available on request.

description_raw: Standard-accuracy optical wavelength meter of the AQ6150 Series with ±0.7 ppm wavelength accuracy (±1 pm at 1550 nm, update rate Normal), intended for inspection of DFB-LDs, tunable lasers, optical transceivers and WDM transmission systems. It uses a Michelson interferometer with FFT processing and real-time correction from a built-in wavelength reference light source, and can measure up to 1024 wavelengths simultaneously with a minimum resolvable separation of 5 GHz. A measurement can be acquired, analyzed and transferred to a PC in 0.2 s or less (update rate Fast), and Auto Gain Control maintains performance down to −40 dBm input power. Built-in functions include single/repeat/average/drift measurement, data logging, FP-LD analysis, WDM (OSNR) analysis and an FFT-based optical spectrum view; remote control is via GP-IB or Ethernet using SCPI commands.

name: High-Resolution Reflectometer
category_path_raw: Optisk test > Våglängdsmätare och övriga optiska instrument
description_raw: The AQ7420 is a spurious-free high-resolution reflectometer for measuring optical return loss distribution in optical components and devices, with a measurement distance range of 100 mm. It offers spatial resolution of 40 µm or less, distance sampling resolution of 1, 4 and 8 µm, and a high sensitivity back reflection range of ‒50 to ‒100 dB, roughly 1000× more sensitive than the predecessor AQ7410. It can measure return loss at two wavelengths simultaneously (1310 nm and 1550 nm with the -1315 suffix) in about ten seconds, and measurement takes approx. 6 seconds. Combined with the AQ740023 Sensor Head it also measures insertion loss, and with the AQ740027 Multi Switch Unit up to 24 fibers can be inspected automatically. Operation is via control software on a customer-supplied Windows 11 PC connected by USB.

name: Xviewer Waveform Viewer Software
description_raw: Xviewer is the waveform viewer software supplied on the standard software CD-ROM together with the SL1000 Acquisition Software. It displays waveform data saved to hard disk offline, supporting cursor measurement, automated measurement of waveform parameters and X-Y display, and allows comments to be added for printing. Waveform binary files can be converted to ASCII (*.csv) or Excel (*.xls) format.

name: Xviewer Math Edition (1 license)
description_raw: One license of the Xviewer Math Edition, supplied with the SL1000 when the /XV1 option is selected. In addition to the standard viewer functions it provides offline waveform computation with up to ten defined math waveforms using arithmetic, trigonometric functions, derivatives, integrals, pulse width computations and FFT.

name: Xviewer Standard Edition (1 license)
description_raw: One license of the Xviewer Standard Edition, included with the SL1000 High-Speed Data Acquisition Unit. It provides offline waveform display, cursor and parameter measurement, X-Y display and conversion of waveform data to CSV or Excel format.

name: Vehicle Edition additional option license (suffix -VE)
description_raw: Separately sold, customer-installable additional option license listed with suffix code -VE (Vehicle Edition).

relations_raw.note: Listed as additional option license in the DL350 ordering information

name: Additional option license for DL950
description_raw: Separately sold, customer-installable license product that adds optional functions to an installed DL950. Available suffix codes are -C40 (IEEE1588 master function), -G02 (user-defined math), -G05 (upgrade /G03 to /G05, adding power math), -MT1 (upgrade /G05 to /MT1, adding motor dq analysis) and -VCE (vehicle edition). The -G05 upgrade requires /G03 already installed and -MT1 requires /G05 already installed.

attributes_raw.prerequisites: -G05 requires /G03 already installed; -MT1 requires /G05 already installed

name: Additional option license for SL2000
description_raw: Separately sold, customer-installable license product that adds optional functions to an installed SL2000. Available suffix codes are -C40 (IEEE1588 master function), -G02 (user-defined math), -G05 (add power math), -MT1 (add motor dq analysis) and -VCE (vehicle edition). The document notes this license product is scheduled for release soon.

name: DL-Term
description_raw: Free command line tool for the DL series library. It supports custom software development but not waveform monitoring, data transfer or command control functions in the comparison table.

name: DL350 Assistant Software
description_raw: Free PC software for data and setup file management of the DL350. Data files or setup configuration files stored on the DL350 SD card can be backed up with the press of a button, and remote setting, start-stop control and setup file editing can be done from the connected PC.

attributes_raw.functions: Backup of SD card data/setup files, remote setting, start-stop control, setup file editing

name: Integrated Software / acquisition software
description_raw: PC software suite for configuring instruments and recording settings for standardized and long-duration tests without complex programming. Units and modules are recognized automatically after startup, and system setup, measurement conditions, display and recording conditions are configured through four wizard screens (Device Connect Wizard, Device Setting Wizard, measuring screen). It connects over USB, 1 Gb Ethernet or 10 Gb Ethernet and is required for real-time 10 GbE data transfer (/C60 option); it is also used to transfer recorded data from the instrument to a PC and is compatible with multi-unit synchronization.

name: MH1 Option (multi-channel vibration and acoustic analysis)
description_raw: MH1 is an option for the IS8000 measurement software platform. It is described as ideal for comparing and calculating multi-channel vibration and acoustic waveforms.

description_raw: SB1 is an option for the IS8000 measurement software platform. It provides CAN bus communication data analysis with decoding, frame display and search.

name: SY1 Option (multi-instrument control and simultaneous data analysis)
description_raw: SY1 is an option for the IS8000 measurement software platform. It is required for controlling more than two measuring instruments and for simultaneous data analysis.

name: Classic Data Viewer Perpetual
description_raw: IS8002CDV Classic Data Viewer is a perpetual-license waveform display software that inherits the design and performance of the 701992 Xviewer, the standard waveform viewer for Yokogawa oscilloscopes and ScopeCorders. It displays up to 90 waveforms per group in up to 10 groups with Main, Zoom, History and X-Y formats, automatically measures 28 waveform parameters and converts waveform files to CSV, WVF or FLD. Instruments can be connected via Ethernet, USB or GP-IB for remote control and waveform download. It does not include the report generator, XviewerEYE or DL850 advanced utility functions of the 701992 Xviewer, and it is available at no extra charge on PCs with a valid IS8001/IS8002 license activated.

description_raw: Free instrument drivers for use in the LabVIEW program development environment provided by National Instruments (NI). They support custom software development.

name: MATLAB WDF Access ToolBox
description_raw: Free toolbox providing access to waveform data files saved in WDF format from MATLAB (a MathWorks product). It is aimed at custom software development.

name: ScopeCorder SDK (Software Development Kit)
description_raw: The ScopeCorder SDK provides an API for waveform data acquisition with the DL950/SL2000, delivered as a Dynamic Link Library (DLL: ScSDK.dll, ScSDKNet.dll, used together with tmctl.dll). Integrating the DLL into a custom Windows application allows automated measurements under PC control. It supports four key operations: Free Run Mode (continuous acquisition from start to stop of the waveform capture), Trigger Mode (capture on a specified trigger event), a flash acquisition data access library that transfers recorded flash acquisition waveforms to a PC, and file operation/transfer of recorded waveforms to a PC. Dedicated waveform display is available through the IS8002CDV Classic Data Viewer.

name: XWirepuller
description_raw: Free software for remote control and waveform display monitoring of a DL350 via USB or Ethernet. It also transfers image files. It is recommended for remote monitoring applications such as power line monitoring in plants and factories.
