name: SL1000 High-Speed Data Acquisition Unit
description_raw: The SL1000 is a modular high-speed data acquisition unit with 8 plug-in module slots and up to 16 channels, sampling at up to 100 MS/s on all channels (10 ns sampling interval). It provides isolated channel hardware, up to four simultaneously independent sample rates for parallel testing, and 50 MW/ch internal acquisition memory. Data can be streamed to a PC via USB 2.0 or optional 1000BASE-T Gigabit Ethernet and saved in real time to a PC hard disk and/or the optional internal 500 GB hard disk at up to 1.6 MS/s (100 kS/s × 16 ch). Up to eight units can be linked with synchronization cables for synchronized measurement of up to 128 channels, and the unit can also be operated standalone using the START/STOP key and built-in LCD. Acquisition Software with Setup Wizard and one license of Xviewer are included; plug-in modules and PC are not included.

name: ScopeCorder DL350
description_raw: Battery-operable, A4-sized portable ScopeCorder that combines oscilloscope and data-recorder functionality in one chassis for in-vehicle and field measurements. Two slots accept any of 17 types of user-swappable input module, giving simultaneous isolated inputs of maximum 8 channels at 1 MS/s or 4 channels at 100 MS/s, scanning inputs up to 32 channels (10 kS/s) or 16 channels (20 kS/s), isolation up to 1 kV and resolution up to 16-bit, plus 16 built-in logic inputs. It offers up to 100 Mpoints of memory per module and direct recording to SD card for up to 50 days of continuous recording. Two operating modes (Recorder mode with setup wizard and Scope mode with history memory of up to 1000 triggered acquisitions) are operated through an 8.4-inch resistive touch screen, and the instrument runs from AC, DC or the built-in rechargeable battery.

attributes_raw.harmonic_analysis: up to 40 harmonic orders (50 or 60 Hz fundamental)
attributes_raw.power_supply: AC 100 to 240 V, DC 10 to 30 V, Li-ion rechargeable battery

name: ScopeCorder
description_raw: The DL950 is an isolated high-speed ScopeCorder that combines oscilloscope-grade sampling and signal fidelity with long-term recorder capabilities. It has eight input slots supporting over 20 plug-in module types for voltage, temperature, acceleration, strain, pulse, logic and vehicle serial bus signals, and samples at up to 200 MS/s with 12/14/16-bit ADC resolution and up to 1000 V input. Up to five DL950/SL2000 units can be synchronized for up to 160 channels, and features include dual capture at two sample rates, multi-sample rates per channel, up to 5,000 history waveforms, Auto Setup, Action-on-Trigger with GO/NO-GO judgement, and Scope Mode / Memory Recorder Mode operation. Data can be stored to a 512 GB built-in SSD, SD card, USB storage up to 8 TB or a network drive, or streamed to a PC over 10 GbE, Ethernet or USB.

attributes_raw.max_channels_synchronized: 160 channels (4 CH module, 5-unit synchronized connection, /C50 option)
attributes_raw.external_storage: SD Memory Card (SD/SDHC/SDXC), USB storage up to 8 TB, network drive

name: SL2000 ScopeCorder
description_raw: Measurement main unit with input module slots, probe power supply terminals (/P4 or /P8), functional ground terminals, trigger and power indicators, a screen showing device status and communication parameters, operation keys and a probe compensation signal output terminal. Rear connectivity includes a 10 Gbps Ethernet terminal (/C60), multi-unit synchronization interface (/C50), GPS and IRIG interfaces (/C35), external I/O terminals for Go/No-Go output and measurement start/stop control, an SD card slot, USB2.0 ports for peripherals, a video signal output (D-sub 9-pin), a 1000BASE-T Ethernet terminal, a USB3.0 PC connection, an external clock input for sampling on an external signal and external trigger I/O terminals. The unit has a handle, tilt legs, air intake and exhaust cooling fan. The SL2000 uses an internal laser light source.

Bandwidth is 400 MHz with an attenuation ratio switchable between 100:1 and 1000:1. Maximum allowed differential voltage is ±2000 V (DC + ACpeak) at 1000:1 and ±200 V at 100:1. An external probe power supply is required.

name: Differential probe, maximum ±20 Vpeak/200 MHz
description_raw: Differential probe (PBD0200) capable of measuring up to 200 MHz and ±20 V, compatible with the YOKOGAWA probe interface. When connected to a supported instrument, the interface enables automatic probe recognition and power supply. Attenuation ratio is 10:1, and maximum input voltage is ±60 V DC / ±42 V ACpeak. It is ideal for measuring automotive bus signals.

name: Connecting cables
description_raw: 3 m connecting cable for the 701953 16-CH Scanner Box.

name: Ethernet Interface
description_raw: Adds a 1000BASE-T Gigabit Ethernet interface to the SL1000. It enables high-speed data transfer to a PC, remote data acquisition over the network, and FTP access to the internal hard disk.

relations_raw.note: Ethernet interface option for the SL1000

name: Internal 500 GB hard drive
description_raw: Adds a built-in 500 GB hard disk to the SL1000 for standalone recording. With this option, measured data can be saved in real time to the internal hard disk at up to 1.6 MS/s (100 kS/s × 16 ch), simultaneously with saving to a PC hard disk when a single unit is used. The internal hard disk can be accessed with Xviewer or via an FTP client over Ethernet.

relations_raw.note: Internal hard disk option for the SL1000

name: Probe power (4-output)
description_raw: Adds a probe power terminal to the SL1000 that supplies power to up to 4 probes. The number of current probes that can be powered from the main unit's probe power supply is limited.

relations_raw.note: Probe power option for the SL1000

name: Without Xviewer
description_raw: Order code for supplying the SL1000 without the Xviewer waveform viewer software license. Only one option from this note group (/XV0 or /XV1) can be selected.

attributes_raw.selection_rule: Only one from the each note can be selected

relations_raw.note: Software selection option for the SL1000

name: With the Xviewer Math Edition (1 license)
description_raw: Supplies the SL1000 with one license of the Xviewer Math Edition (701992-GP01) instead of the standard edition. The Math Edition adds offline waveform computation, allowing up to ten computed waveforms (Math1 to Math10) using arithmetic, trigonometric functions, differentiation, integration, pulse width computations and FFT. Only one option from this note group (/XV0 or /XV1) can be selected.

attributes_raw.operations: +, –, ×, /, trigonometry, differentiation, integration, FFT, and others

relations_raw.note: Software selection option for the SL1000

name: High-speed sampling input module (100 MS/s)
description_raw: Plug-in input module used in the DL350 to sample at 100 MS/s, referenced in the brochure for accurately reconstructing fast switching signals such as inverter gate signals (20 kHz), which a 1 MS/s acquisition cannot resolve as precisely. The brochure describes the DL350's high-speed module as providing individually isolated 12-bit inputs at 100 MS/s with 1 kV isolation for capturing transients superimposed on slower signals. Recording-time tables in the brochure are based on one module of 720211 (1 ch) and two modules of 720211 (4 ch).

relations_raw.note: Used in the DL350 slots; brochure recording tables based on 720211
ScopeCorder series plug-in module for the SL1000

name: High-speed 200 MS/s 14 Bit Isolation Module
description_raw: Two-channel isolated analog voltage input module with 200 MS/s sampling, 14-bit resolution and 40 MHz bandwidth. Maximum measurement voltage is 1000 V (DC+ACpeak) with a 700929, 702902 or 701947 probe, or 200 V with 701901 + 701954. DC accuracy is ±0.5%. The module uses an internal laser light source and is a Class 1 Laser Product (IEC60825-1:2014+A11:2021, IEC 60825-1:2014, GB 7247.1-2024). Probes are not included with the module.

name: 16 CH voltage measurement module (Scan-type)
description_raw: Scan-type module for 16-channel voltage measurement at 200 kS/s with 16-bit resolution and 5 kHz bandwidth. Channels are isolated from ground but not channel-to-channel, with a maximum measurement voltage of 20 V direct input and ±0.3% DC accuracy. According to the module table, the 720220 does not support the DL950.

name: 16 CH Temp./Voltage Input Module
description_raw: Isolated 16-channel scan-method module for voltage or temperature measurement at 10 S/s with 16-bit voltage resolution, 0.1 °C temperature resolution and 600 Hz bandwidth. Maximum measurement voltage is 20 V with ±0.15% voltage accuracy, and thermocouples K, E, J, T, L, U, N, R, S, B, W and Au-Fe-chromel are supported. The 16 CH Scanner Box 701953 is required for measurement.

name: Logic Input Module
description_raw: Plug-in logic input module for acquiring digital/logic signals alongside analog channels. Logic waveforms support automated parameter measurement (Freq, Period, Pulse, Duty, Avg.Freq, Delay) and logic-pattern searching. Probes are not included with the module.

attributes_raw.logic_parameters: Freq, Period, Pulse, Duty, Avg.Freq, Delay

name: CAN & LIN Bus Monitor Module
description_raw: CAN and LIN bus monitor module referenced in the module footnotes. When used with DL950/VCE, up to four bus monitor modules (720241, 720242, 720245, 720243) in total can be used on a single main unit, and up to two in total of 720241, 720242 and 720245. It can be installed in slots 7 and 8.

attributes_raw.slots: can be installed in slots 7 and 8
attributes_raw.module_limit: up to two of 720241/720242/720245 in total per main unit

name: CAN/CAN FD Monitor Module
description_raw: CAN/CAN FD bus monitor module referenced in the module footnotes. When used with DL950/VCE, up to four bus monitor modules (720242, 720241, 720245, 720243) in total can be used on a single main unit, and up to two in total of 720241, 720242 and 720245. It can be installed in slots 7 and 8.

attributes_raw.slots: can be installed in slots 7 and 8
attributes_raw.module_limit: up to two of 720241/720242/720245 in total per main unit

name: SENT Monitor Module
description_raw: Isolated SENT bus monitor module sampling at 100 kS/s with 11 data × 2 ports and a maximum measurement voltage of 42 V. Supported protocol is SAE J2716. It is available for DL950/VCE and the DL350 /VE option and can be installed in slots 5 to 8.

attributes_raw.slots: can be installed in slots 5 to 8

name: CAN FD/LIN Monitor Module
description_raw: Bus monitor module that extracts specified data from CAN FD and Classical CAN serial signals, converts them into analog values and records their trends, automatically discriminating between the two formats. It provides 2 CAN/CAN FD ports and 2 LIN ports (CAN FD/LIN switchable per port), 60 signals per port at 100 kS/s, with CAN/CAN FD data up to 32-bit. Isolated inputs are rated 10 V on the CAN port and 18 V on the LIN port. It is available for the DL950/VCE and for the DL350 with the /VE option; with the module in both DL350 slots up to 240 channels can be recorded.

attributes_raw.ports: CAN/CAN FD port × 2, LIN port × 2, switchable on each port separately

relations_raw.note: Available for DL950/VCE; max two bus monitor modules in total per DL950/VCE main unit

name: High-speed 10 MS/s 12 Bit Isolation Module
description_raw: Two-channel isolated analog voltage module with 10 MS/s sampling, 12-bit resolution and 3 MHz bandwidth. Maximum measurement voltage is 800 V (DC+ACpeak) with a 700929, 702902 or 701947 probe, or 200 V with 701901 + 701954. DC accuracy is ±0.5% and the module offers high noise immunity.

relations_raw.note: ScopeCorder series plug-in module for the SL1000

name: 4-CH 1 MS/s 16-Bit Isolation Module
description_raw: Four-channel isolated analog input module with BNC inputs, 1 MS/s sampling, 16-bit resolution and 300 kHz bandwidth. It provides low noise and high noise immunity with a DC accuracy of ±0.25%, and measures up to 600 V (DC+ACpeak) with a probe or 200 V with the 701901 + 701954 combination. With this module in both DL350 slots the instrument reaches 8 analog channels.

relations_raw.note: Two 720254 modules used for the 8-ch recording examples

name: 4 CH 10MS/s 16 Bit Isolation Module
description_raw: Four-channel isolated analog voltage input module with BNC inputs, 10 MS/s sampling, 16-bit resolution and 3 MHz bandwidth. Maximum measurement voltage is 600 V (DC+ACpeak) with a 700929, 702902 or 701947 probe, or 200 V with 701901 + 701954. DC accuracy is ±0.25% and the module features low noise and high noise immunity.

name: Temperature/High-precision Voltage Isolation Module (Low noise)
description_raw: Two-channel isolated low-noise module for temperature and high-precision voltage measurement, sampling at 125 S/s for voltage and temperature with 16-bit voltage resolution, 0.1 °C temperature resolution and 15 Hz bandwidth. Maximum measurement voltage is 42 V and voltage accuracy is printed as ±0.08. It provides a 0.1 mV/div high sensitivity range and supports thermocouples K, E, J, T, L, U, N, R, S, B, W and iron-doped gold/chromel.

attributes_raw.sensitivity: 0.1 mV/div high sensitivity range, low noise

relations_raw.note: ScopeCorder series plug-in module for the SL1000

name: High Voltage Input Module
description_raw: High-voltage, high-resolution isolation input module with 16-bit resolution and 1 MS/s sample rate, capable of direct RMS measurements. It accepts a maximum input voltage of 1000 Vrms and uses a new digital isolator so that high-voltage input signals can be acquired without increasing module size and without compromising the common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR). Like other DL350 input modules it is powered by Yokogawa's isoPRO technology, which uses optical fibers for high-speed data transmission and high-voltage isolation.

relations_raw.note: New high-voltage isolation module for the DL350
Document states DL350 input modules are compatible with the DL950 ScopeCorders
ScopeCorder series plug-in module for the SL1000

name: Frequency Module
description_raw: Two-channel isolated frequency module sampling at 1 MS/s with 16-bit resolution and 625 ps time resolution. It measures frequencies from 0.01 Hz to 500 kHz and derives frequency, RPM, RPS, period, duty cycle, power supply frequency, pulse width, pulse integration and velocity. Maximum measurement voltage is 420 V with a 700929, 702902 or 701947 probe, or 42 V direct input, with ±0.1% frequency accuracy.

attributes_raw.measured_parameters: frequency, RPM, RPS, period, duty cycle, power supply frequency, pulse width, pulse integration, velocity

relations_raw.note: ScopeCorder series plug-in module for the SL1000

name: Synchronous cable
description_raw: 1 m synchronization cable for the SL1000, used to link units via the SYNC IN/SYNC OUT connectors. Up to eight units can be linked for synchronized measurement of up to 128 channels.

relations_raw.note: Synchronous cable for SL1000 unit linkage

name: Synchronous connecting cable
description_raw: Synchronous connecting cable for the SL1000, 3 m long. Enables synchronous operation of up to 8 units with a total connection cable length of 10 m or less.

attributes_raw.max_units: 8 units (total cable length 10 m or less)

relations_raw.note: Synchronous cable for SL1000 unit linkage

name: 60 W AC Adapter
description_raw: AC adapter for the DL350, required to operate the main unit from mains and to charge the battery pack. It accepts 100 to 240 VAC (permitted range 90 to 264 VAC) at 50/60 Hz with a maximum power consumption of 120 VA. It is a separate purchase and is not included with the main unit.

attributes_raw.withstand_voltage: 3 kV (between the main unit and AC adapter power line)

name: DC cable (Cigarette lighter plug Type)
description_raw: DC power cable with cigarette lighter plug, 2.5 m long, for powering the DL350 from a vehicle supply. Rated supply voltage at the DL350 connector end is 10 to 30 VDC with a maximum power consumption of 45 W.

attributes_raw.rated_supply_voltage: 10 to 30 VDC (at the DL350 connector end)

name: Battery Pack Cover
description_raw: Cover required for operating the 739883 battery pack in the DL350. It is included in the /EB option.

name: GPS unit
description_raw: Optional GPS unit for the DL350 that adds coordinate information to recorded data and synchronizes the instrument time, connected via a Mini DIN 9-pin input. It receives GPS/GLONASS/QZSS/SBAS (MSAS/WAAS/EGNOS/GAGAN) and acquires latitude, longitude, altitude, speed, moving direction and GPS information. Horizontal position accuracy is 15 m or less and speed accuracy 1 m/s (GPS information/SA=OFF/PDOP≤3). The GPS unit can only be supplied to countries where it is not prohibited by local radio laws.

attributes_raw.measurement_accuracy: Horizontal position: 15 m or less; Speed: 1 m/s (GPS information/SA=OFF/PDOP≤3)
attributes_raw.following_performance: Altitude −500 to +18000 m, speed 1800 km/h or less, acceleration 2 G or less
attributes_raw.measurement_resolution: Latitude/longitude 1 µ°, altitude 0.1 m/1 m, speed 0.01 km/h / 0.1 km/h, direction 0.01°

name: Battery Pack
description_raw: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery pack for the DL350 giving approximately 3 hours of operation and charging in approximately 6 hours when the instrument is off. The AC adapter 720921 is required for charging and the battery pack cover 720923 is required for operation. It is included in the /EB option.

attributes_raw.charge_time: Approx. 6 hours (When the DL350 is turned off.)
attributes_raw.requires: 720923 battery pack cover, 720921 AC adapter for charging

name: Rack mounting kit
description_raw: Rack mounting kit for the SL1000 conforming to the EIA standard.

name: Rack mounting kit
description_raw: Rack mounting kit for the SL1000 conforming to the JIS standard.

name: Rack mounting kit
description_raw: Rack mounting kit for an EIA-compliant single-housing rack. It is listed in the DL950/SL2000 accessory table.

name: Rack mounting kit
description_raw: Rack mounting kit for a JIS-compliant single-housing rack. It is listed in the DL950/SL2000 accessory table.

name: Safety BNC-banana adapter
description_raw: Safety adapter converting a BNC input to banana connections, rated 500 Vrms CAT II. It is used to connect banana-terminated leads to the instrument's BNC inputs.

name: Pinchers tip (Hook type)
description_raw: Hook-type pincher tips rated 1000 Vrms CAT III, supplied as one set each of red and black. They are used in combination with the 701904 safety adapter lead.

attributes_raw.contents: 1 set each of red and black

name: Alligator clip adaptor set
description_raw: Alligator clip adaptor set rated 1000 Vrms CAT II, supplied as one set each of red and black. It is used with the 701904 safety adapter lead and, together with 758917, is required for measurement with the 700987 isolation logic probe.

attributes_raw.contents: 1 set each of red and black

name: Measurement lead set
description_raw: Measurement lead set used with the isolated inputs. In combination with 758933 and the 701954 large alligator clips, the 720268 module reaches its maximum measurement voltage of 1000 Vrms (1000 VDC or 1414 Vpeak maximum).

relations_raw.note: Standard accessory and listed optional accessory for GS610

name: NDIS connector
description_raw: NDIS connector for direct connection to a strain module of a ScopeCorder.

name: Front cover
description_raw: Front panel protective cover for the DLM4000 oscilloscopes.

name: 4 mm conversion adapter
description_raw: Conversion adapter for the 702902, 702906 and 702907 probes, used for connecting to the high voltage measurement terminal adapters. This version is the pincher tip end variant.

attributes_raw.application: Connecting to high voltage measurement terminal adapters

name: 4 mm conversion adapter
description_raw: Conversion adapter for the 702902, 702906 and 702907 probes, used for connecting to the high voltage measurement terminal adapters. This version is the ground lead end variant.

attributes_raw.application: Connecting to high voltage measurement terminal adapters

name: Front panel protective cover
description_raw: Front panel protective cover for the DL950 ScopeCorder.

name: Front cover
description_raw: Front panel protective cover for the DLM3000/3000HD oscilloscopes.

name: Front panel protective cover
description_raw: Front panel protective cover for the DLM5000/5000HD oscilloscopes.

name: IC clip
description_raw: IC clips that attach to the tips of the 701988 or 701989 logic probes. They allow clipping of contiguous 0.5 mm pitch terminals. A total of 10 clips are included.

name: Pincher tip (Red)
description_raw: Red pincher tip rated 1000 Vrms CAT III, used in combination with the 1:1 safety adapter lead.

name: Pincher tip (Black)
description_raw: Black pincher tip rated 1000 Vrms CAT III, used in combination with the 1:1 safety adapter lead.

name: Printer paper
description_raw: Printer paper for the DLM3000/3000HD/4000/5000/5000HD oscilloscopes. Sales unit is 10; orders must be a multiple of the order quantity.

name: Battery pack + Battery pack cover
description_raw: Option that includes the lithium-ion battery pack (739883) and the battery pack cover (720923) for the DL350. It allows the instrument to be operated without external power for approximately 3 hours. The AC adapter 720921 is required to charge the battery.

attributes_raw.includes: 739883 battery pack and 720923 battery pack cover

name: Vehicle serial bus decode option (CAN/CAN FD, LIN, SENT)
description_raw: Option for the DL350 that, combined with a bus monitor module, decodes CAN/CAN FD, LIN bus and SENT signals. Decoded physical values such as engine temperature, vehicle speed and brake pedal position are displayed as trend waveforms and can be compared with analog sensor data. A symbol editor software tool defines which physical values from the CAN/CAN FD or LIN data frames are trended, and it can import vehicle definition files (CAN DBC *.dbc, LIN LDF *.ldf) and export symbol definition files (*.sbl).

name: IRIG, GPS interface
description_raw: Interface option that enables time synchronization using IRIG and GPS signals. It is used for synchronized monitoring at multiple, geographically distributed locations, for example wind turbine power generation efficiency. It is also used when connecting a GPS unit to add latitude, longitude, altitude, speed, direction and time information to measurement data.

name: IEEE1588 master function
description_raw: Option for time synchronization with IEEE1588 (PTP) signals, which also allows the DL950 to output IEEE1588 master signals. IEEE1588 provides clock synchronization with an error of less than 1 µs. Simultaneous measurement of remote devices is possible with a synchronization accuracy of ±150 ns (typ) when using this option.

name: Multi-unit synchronization interface
description_raw: Option for synchronized operation of multiple units: up to four sub-units can be connected to one main unit for up to 160 channels with 4 CH modules. It provides synchronized start/stop control and time alignment between units, and the main unit can remotely display and operate the screen of one sub-unit at a time. Synchronization is supported between DL950 and SL2000 units in any combination and is compatible with IS8000, the built-in web server and video signal output.

name: 10 Gbps Ethernet real-time data transfer
description_raw: Option enabling real-time data transfer to a PC over 10 Gbps Ethernet, storing up to 20 MS/s of data in real time. An SFP+ module, a fiber optic cord and the PC software IS8000 are required for the transfer; commercially available SFP+ modules and 10 GE fiber optic cords are used. High-speed transfer is not possible when transferring files.

attributes_raw.required_items: SFP+ module, fiber optic cord, IS8000 software

name: User-defined math function
description_raw: Enables user-defined equations built from operators such as ABS, SQRT, LOG, EXP, SIN, COS, TAN, ATAN, DIF, INTG, FILT1, FILT2, HLBT and MEAN. It also adds the exponential FFT time window and FFT averaging settings (simple, exponential, peak) in Scope mode. Averaging can be set as simple, exponential, cycle average or peak computation.

attributes_raw.operators: ABS, SQRT, LOG, EXP, NEG, SIN, COS, TAN, ATAN, PH, DIF, DDIF, INTG, IINTG, BIN, P2, P3, F1, F2, FV, PWHH, PWHL, PWLH, PWLL, PWXX, DUTYH, DUTYL, FILT1, FILT2, HLBT, MEAN

name: Real time math function
description_raw: Adds hardware-based real time math with up to 16 math channels separate from the input channels, computed at up to 10 MS/s (1 MS/s for polynomials). Math types include arithmetic, angle math, quartic polynomial, differentiation, integration, frequency, period, edge count, PWM demodulation, torque, rms, effective power, resolver and IIR filtering. Results are stored as single-precision floating point (32 bit). Only one of /G03, /G05 and /MT1 can be selected.

attributes_raw.exclusivity: Only one of /G03, /G05, /MT1 can be selected

name: Power math function (including Real time math function)
description_raw: Adds real time power analysis math on top of the real time math function, computing up to two three-phase systems simultaneously at up to 10 MS/s with a minimum analysis period of 0.1 ms (10 kHz). Power items include rms voltage/current, active, apparent and reactive power, power factor, phase difference, integrated watt-hour and ampere-hour, unbalance factors and efficiency; results are output on RTMATH13/14 and harmonic results on RTMATH15/16. Harmonic analysis covers the 1st to 40th harmonic (rms mode) with 4096 FFT points, and the /G05 option also enables the Auto Timer math sync mode. Only one of /G03, /G05 and /MT1 can be selected.

attributes_raw.analyzable_systems: Up to two three-phase systems simultaneously
attributes_raw.math_parameters: 118 when one system is measured, 58 × 2 systems for two systems
attributes_raw.harmonic_analysis: 1st to 40th harmonic (rms mode), 1st to 35th (power mode), FFT points 4096
attributes_raw.exclusivity: Only one of /G03, /G05, /MT1 can be selected

name: Memory expansion to 4 G Points
description_raw: Memory expansion option raising the acquisition memory to 4 G Points, with a maximum of 2 G Points per channel. It extends the selectable record length up to 2 G (2 CH). Only one of /M1 and /M2 can be selected.

attributes_raw.exclusivity: Only one of /M1, /M2 can be selected

name: 8 G points large memory
description_raw: Memory expansion option providing up to 8 G points of acquisition memory, with up to 4 G points allocated per channel. It enables 20 seconds of continuous capture even at 200 MS/s, so no signal changes are missed. Capture times range from 20 s at 200 MS/s (1–2 CH) to 1 hour at 1 MS/s (1–2 CH).

attributes_raw.continuous_capture: 20 s at 200 MS/s (1 CH or 2 CH)

name: Motor dq analysis function
description_raw: Option performing Park and Clarke transformations from motor voltage/current, battery DC signals and rotational position, giving real-time dq-axis voltage (Vd, Vq) and current (Id, Iq) waveforms. The dq analysis can be calculated alongside other motor parameters, power measurement and harmonic analysis, and a single DL950 can integrate additional measurements such as vibration, temperature and CAN data. It also supports power and harmonics analysis and the encoder rotary angle function.

attributes_raw.function: Motor dq analysis (Park and Clarke transformation)
attributes_raw.outputs: dq-axis voltage (Vd, Vq), dq-axis current (Id, Iq)
attributes_raw.combined_analysis: Power measurement, harmonic analysis, encoder rotary angle

name: Four probe power outputs
description_raw: Provides four probe power output terminals at ±12 V for powering current and differential probes, with up to a total of 2.4 A output current. Either this main-unit probe power option or the external 701934 probe power supply is required for the powered probes. Only one of /P4 and /P8 can be selected.

attributes_raw.output_current: Up to a total of 2.4 A
attributes_raw.exclusivity: Only one of /P4, /P8 can be selected

name: Eight probe power outputs
description_raw: Provides eight probe power output terminals at ±12 V for powering current and differential probes, with up to a total of 4.8 A output current. Either this main-unit probe power option or the external 701934 probe power supply is required for the powered probes. Only one of /P4 and /P8 can be selected.

attributes_raw.output_current: Up to a total of 4.8 A
attributes_raw.exclusivity: Only one of /P4, /P8 can be selected

name: SSD recording
description_raw: Option enabling recording to the 512 GB internal SSD for long periods at up to 2 MS/s. Waveforms from the dual capture function can also be recorded, which is useful for in-vehicle endurance testing and rare spontaneous events. With the /M2 option, recording time ranges from 5 hours at 2 MS/s (1 CH) up to 50 days at 1 kS/s.

name: SSD recording and flash acquisition
description_raw: Option providing SSD recording plus the flash acquisition function, which records for long periods at up to 20 MS/s — 100 times faster than the previous model. The flash memory is non-volatile, so captured data remains in the instrument after power off and can later be transferred to a PC, making it suitable for on-vehicle or field testing without a PC. With the /M2 option, flash acquisition time ranges from 10 minutes at 20 MS/s to 5 hours at 1 MS/s. Recorded flash data is deleted for all data at once, not per recording.

attributes_raw.max_flash_capture_time: 5 h at 1 MS/s (1–4 CH, with /M2 option)
attributes_raw.recording_media: 512 GB internal SSD, internal flash memory

name: Vehicle bus monitor option (DL950/VCE)
description_raw: Option version of the DL950 referenced for vehicle bus measurement. The CAN FD/LIN Monitor Module 720245 and the SENT Monitor Module 720243 are available for DL950/VCE (and DL350/VE). When using these modules with DL950/VCE, up to four CAN/CAN FD (720242), CAN & LIN (720241), CAN FD/LIN (720245) or SENT (720243) modules in total can be used on a single main unit, and up to two in total of 720241, 720242 and 720245.

name: Math Function for 1 PC
description_raw: Waveform math option licence for one PC for the IS8002CDV Classic Data Viewer. It enables up to 32 math waveforms (Math1 to Math32) defined from measured data, FFT analysis with up to 2 M points and digital filter computation (Gauss, Sharp, IIR). Maximum number of computed points is 12.5 M points depending on the number of math channels. The math function is available at no extra charge on PCs with a valid IS8001/IS8002 license activated.

name: Math Function for 5 PCs
description_raw: Waveform math option licence for five PCs for the IS8002CDV Classic Data Viewer. Same functionality as /M01 but licensed for five PCs.

name: Math Function for 10 PCs
description_raw: Waveform math option licence for ten PCs for the IS8002CDV Classic Data Viewer. It provides up to 32 math waveforms, FFT analysis up to 2 M points and digital filters (Gauss, Sharp, IIR) with a maximum of 12.5 M computed points. Same functionality as /M01 but licensed for ten PCs.

description_raw: Waveform math option licence for twenty PCs for the IS8002CDV Classic Data Viewer. name: 10G Ethernet Multi Field Tester (MFT-10GbE)
description_raw: Handheld Ethernet field tester covering 10M to 10G for network path testing and maintenance. It provides RJ-45 (10BASE-T/100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T), SFP (100BASE-FX/1000BASE-SX/1000BASE-LX) and XFP (10GBASE-SR/LR/ER) test ports, and tests at L2, L3-IPv4 and L3-IPv6 with throughput, frame loss, latency, error frame, BERT, QoS and PING measurements. The document calls it the world's smallest in-class 10G Ethernet tester at A5 size and approx. 1.3 kg including battery pack, with a 5.7-inch 640x480 colour TFT LCD. RFC2544 and the dedicated optical power meter port are factory options on this model; battery operating time is approx. 1 hour.

attributes_raw.test_menus: Auto, Auto (Remote), Manual, RFC2544, ITU-T Y.1564, VLAN Test, E-OAM, OPM
attributes_raw.qos_channels: Up to 8 channels (up to 4 in Auto and Auto (Remote) modes)
attributes_raw.logging: 1 second interval, up to 72 hours, up to 4 items

name: 1G Ethernet Multi Field Tester (MFT-1GbE)
description_raw: Handheld Ethernet field tester covering 10M to 1G for network path testing and maintenance. It offers RJ-45 (10BASE-T/100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T) and SFP (100BASE-FX/1000BASE-SX/1000BASE-LX) test ports and tests at L2, L3-IPv4 and L3-IPv6 with throughput, frame loss, latency, error frame, BERT, QoS and PING. RFC2544 measurement is standard on this model; the XFP port, LFS generation/detection and the optical power meter option are not available. Battery operating time is approx. 2 hours and the unit weighs approx. 1.3 kg including battery pack.

name: FieldMate Versatile Device Management Wizard
description_raw: PC-based device configuration and management tool for initial setup, daily maintenance, troubleshooting and configuration backup of field devices. It supports BRAIN, FOUNDATION Fieldbus H1, HART and ISA100.11a protocols as well as other vendors' devices. Together with the CA700 it can remotely control the calibrator, includes calibration procedures for pressure transmitters, automatically records calibration data, calculates relative error and pass/fail determination and generates test reports. Recorded calibration data can be registered in the FieldMate device maintenance database for later analysis.

attributes_raw.supported_protocols: BRAIN, FOUNDATION Fieldbus H1, HART, ISA100.11a
attributes_raw.functions: Remote control of CA700, embedded pressure transmitter calibration procedures, automatic calibration data recording, relative error calculation, pass/fail determination, automatic test report generation

relations_raw.note: Controls the CA700 remotely and manages calibration data

name: Curve Tracer Software
description_raw: PC software that turns a GS series Source Measure Unit into a real-time I/V curve tracer for DC parametric tests of small signals. The PC is connected to the source measure unit via USB, giving a compact and light system with a simple configuration. Together with the high-speed communication and sweep features of the GS series it reaches a graph update rate of up to 20 pages/s with the GS820.

attributes_raw.connection: USB cable between PC and GS series Source Measure Unit

relations_raw.note: GS series Source Measure Unit; GS820 update rate stated

name: Optical transceiver module
description_raw: Separately orderable optical transceiver modules for the AQ1300/AQ1301 test ports. Suffix -SR, -LR and -ER provide 10GBASE-SR/LR/ER XFP modules (AQ1300 only), while -SX and -LX provide 1000BASE-SX and 1000BASE-LX SFP modules. Yokogawa states that only the listed SFP/XFP modules should be used; other modules void functionality, performance and warranty.

relations_raw.note: XFP variants (-SR/-LR/-ER) cannot be used with the AQ1301

name: Connector adapter for optical power meters
description_raw: Connector adapters for the optical power meter port of the AQ1300. Suffix -SCC gives an SC connector adapter and -FCC an FC connector adapter. The brochure notes these adapters cannot be used with the AQ1301, which has no optical power meter option.

attributes_raw.variants: -SCC SC connector adapter, -FCC FC connector adapter
attributes_raw.compatible_with: AQ1300 optical power meter port (cannot be used with the AQ1301)

relations_raw.note: For the /SPML optical power meter port

name: AC adapter
description_raw: Spare AC adapter for the AQ1300/AQ1301 testers, ordered with a power cord suffix matching the destination country standard. Available suffixes are -D (UL/CSA 125 V), -F (VDE 250 V), -R (Australian 250 V), -Q (BS/Singaporean 250 V), -H (Chinese 250 V), -P (Korean 250 V) and -T (Taiwanese 125 V). An AC adapter and power cable are also included as standard accessories.

attributes_raw.power_cord_suffixes: -D UL/CSA 125 V, -F VDE 250 V, -R Australian 250 V, -Q BS/Singaporean 250 V, -H Chinese 250 V, -P Korean 250 V, -T Taiwanese 125 V

name: Battery pack (reserve)
description_raw: Spare battery pack for the AQ1300/AQ1301 Ethernet multi field testers. A battery pack is included as a standard accessory; this item is the reserve unit for extended field work. Operating time is approx. 2 hours on the AQ1301 and approx. 1 hour on the AQ1300, with approx. 5 hours charging time.

name: RFC2544 function
description_raw: Option adding the RFC2544 automated benchmarking test function to the AQ1300. It measures throughput, latency, frame loss rate, back-to-back and packet jitter, with test duration 1 to 999 sec and 1 to 60 trials, in a two-unit configuration with the far-end unit in loop back mode. Reports can be output as csv, image (jpg or png) or pdf. It cannot be specified for the AQ1301, where the function is standard.

attributes_raw.test_items: Throughput, latency, frame loss rate, back-to-back, packet jitter

name: 10GBASE-ER XFP module
description_raw: 10GBASE-ER XFP optical transceiver module ordered as an option with the AQ1300 for long-reach 10G Ethernet testing on the XFP test port. It cannot be specified for the AQ1301. Only Yokogawa-listed XFP modules may be used.

relations_raw.note: Cannot be used with the AQ1301

name: 10GBASE-LR XFP module
description_raw: 10GBASE-LR XFP optical transceiver module ordered as an option with the AQ1300 for 10G Ethernet testing on its XFP test port. It cannot be specified for the AQ1301. Only Yokogawa-listed XFP modules may be used, otherwise functionality, performance and warranty are not guaranteed.

relations_raw.note: Cannot be used with the AQ1301

name: 1000BASE-LX SFP module
description_raw: 1000BASE-LX SFP optical transceiver module ordered as an option with the AQ1300 or AQ1301. It is fitted in the SFP test port for gigabit Ethernet testing over single-mode fiber. Only SFP modules listed by Yokogawa may be used or the warranty will be void.

name: Shoulder belt
description_raw: Shoulder belt supplied as a factory-ordered option for the AQ1300/AQ1301 testers. It supports hands-free carrying during field work. The same item is also available separately as accessory B8070CY.

name: Standard Optical power meter
description_raw: Factory-installed optical power meter option with a dedicated measurement port on the AQ1300. Measurement wavelengths are 850/1300/1310/1490/1550/1625/1650 nm with a power range of -70 dBm to +10 dBm (CW) and -70 dBm to +7 dBm (CHOP). Accuracy is ±5% (Ta=23±2°C, at 1310 nm, -10 dBm, SM fiber) and the port uses a universal connector (1.25 mm dia.), with SC and FC adapters available. Cannot be specified for the AQ1301.

attributes_raw.measurement_power_range: -70 dBm to +10 dBm (CW), -70 dBm to +7 dBm (CHOP)
attributes_raw.optical_connector: Universal connector (1.25 mm dia.), SC, FC (accessory connector adapter required)
attributes_raw.compatible_with: AQ1300 only (cannot be specified for the AQ1301)

relations_raw.note: Factory option; not available for AQ1301

name: 10GBASE-SR XFP module
description_raw: 10GBASE-SR XFP optical transceiver module ordered as an option with the AQ1300. It is used in the XFP test port for 10G Ethernet testing. It cannot be specified for the AQ1301, which has no XFP port. Only Yokogawa-listed XFP modules may be used or functionality, performance and warranty are void.

relations_raw.note: Cannot be used with the AQ1301

name: 1000BASE-SX SFP module
description_raw: 1000BASE-SX SFP optical transceiver module ordered as an option with the AQ1300 or AQ1301. It is fitted in the SFP test port for gigabit Ethernet testing over multimode fiber. Only SFP modules listed by Yokogawa may be used or the warranty will be void.

name: Shoulder belt
description_raw: Shoulder belt accessory for the AQ1300/AQ1301 handheld testers, orderable separately from the /SB factory option. It allows the tester to be carried hands-free in the field.

relations_raw.note: Shoulder belt, also available as /SB option
